content:
以下是 2026 年 10 月 28 日国会研究服务部报告《联邦海洋研究船队：国会面临的问题》。摘自报告 联邦海洋学研究船队是推进海洋系统知识的主要工具。联邦海洋学船队主要由联邦部门和机构拥有、运营或租赁的海洋学研究船组成。联邦政府资助的项目包括绘制海底地图，这有助于划定美国海洋边界的外部界限；识别和研究海洋资源以进行保护、管理或开发；海洋探索；美国北极和南极研究；以及美国广泛的海洋研究，包括美国海洋观测网络的安装、拆除和维护。其中一些活动还有助于实现各种国家安全目标。国会面临的问题是了解联邦海洋学舰队的当前能力及其未来及时且具有成本效益的方式支持海洋研究和相关国家安全优先事项的能力。 2016 年 3 月，设施和基础设施机构间工作组 (IWG-FI) 发布了联邦海洋研究船状态报告，题为《联邦船队状态报告：当前容量和近期优先事项》。
在本报告中，IWG-FI 清点了 2015 财年末组成联邦船队的海洋研究船。2016 年联邦船队状况报告还提供了到 2030 财年船队能力的展望，并讨论了与能力变化相关的潜在影响。 IWG-FI 是一个非国会授权的工作组，由美国国家海洋和大气管理局 (NOAA) 和海军部共同主持，自 2016 年以来就没有发布联邦舰队状况报告。2016 年联邦舰队状况报告包括 NOAA、海军部、国家科学基金会和美国海岸警卫队拥有、运营或租赁的船只。自2016年船队状况报告发布以来，已有多艘海洋研究船从船队退役、加入船队或需要维护以延长使用寿命。 IWG-FI 于 2023 年开始准备新的更新的联邦机队状态报告。2024 年，NOAA 承认正在准备 2016 年联邦机队状态报告的更新，但该机构没有提供发布时间表。迄今为止，2016 年报告仍然是联邦海洋学船队最全面的公开评估。
国会对联邦海洋学舰队的决策可以极大地影响联邦机构履行其任务（例如科学研究、教育和航行安全）的能力以及舰队解决某些国家安全问题的能力。有关联邦海洋学舰队的定期状态报告可以为国会对舰队的审议和决策提供信息。国会可以采取多种选择来强制报告联邦舰队的状况；在此过程中，它可以具体说明报告的内容。例如，国会可以指示报告在发布时清点舰队；提供有关机构未来计划的更多详细信息，包括维持、扩大或缩小机队规模以满足不断变化的国会的资金需求

【原文 English Original】
The following is the Oct. 28, 2026, Congressional Research Service report, The Federal Fleet of Oceanographic Research Vessels: Issues for Congress. From the Report The federal fleet of oceanographic research vessels serves as a primary tool for advancing knowledge of the ocean system. The federal oceanographic fleet is primarily composed of oceanographic research vessels that are owned and operated or leased by federal departments and agencies. Federally funded projects have included the mapping of the seafloor, which aids in the delineation of the outer limits of U.S. maritime boundaries; the identification and study of marine resources for protection, management, or exploitation; ocean exploration; U.S. Arctic and Antarctic research; and U.S. ocean-based research broadly, including the installation, removal, and maintenance of U.S. ocean observation networks. Some of these activities also contribute to various national security objectives. At issue for Congress is understanding the current capacity of the federal oceanographic fleet and its future capability to support ocean research and related national security priorities in a timely and cost-effective manner. In March 2016, the Interagency Working Group on Facilities and Infrastructure (IWG-FI) published a federal oceanographic research vessel status report entitled Federal Fleet Status Report: Current Capacity and Near-Term Priorities. In this report, the IWG-FI inventoried the oceanographic research vessels that composed the federal fleet at the end of FY2015. The 2016 federal fleet status report also provided an outlook of the fleet’s capacity through FY2030 and discussed the potential impacts associated with changes to capacity. The IWG-FI, a non-congressionally mandated working group that is cochaired by the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) and the Department of Navy, has not published a federal fleet status report since 2016. The 2016 federal fleet status report included vessels owned and operated or leased by NOAA, the Department of the Navy, the National Science Foundation, and the U.S. Coast Guard. Since the publication of the 2016 fleet status report, several oceanographic research vessels have retired from the fleet, entered into the fleet, or required maintenance to extend their service lives. The IWG-FI began preparing a new updated federal fleet status report in 2023. In 2024, NOAA acknowledged that an update to the 2016 federal fleet status report was being prepared, but the agency provided no timeline for its publication. To date, the 2016 report remains the most comprehensive publicly available assessment of the federal oceanographic fleet. Congressional decision making on the federal oceanographic fleet can substantially affect federal agencies’ abilities to fulfill their missions (e.g., science and research, education, and navigation safety) and the fleet’s ability to address certain national security concerns. Recurring status reports about the federal oceanographic fleet could inform congressional deliberation over and decisions related to the fleet. Congress could pursue several options for mandating reporting on the federal fleet status; in doing so, it could specify the report’s contents. For example, Congress could direct the report to inventory the fleet at the time of publication; provide additional details about agencies’ future plans, including funding needs to maintain, expand, or reduce the fleet’s size to meet evolving congressional priorities; or both. Alternatively, Congress could choose to maintain the status quo and defer to the executive branch on whether, and if so when and how, to update the federal fleet status report. Given that oceanographic research vessels are a shared federal asset, improved collaboration among federal agencies might allow the government to reduce the number of vessels in the fleet and thus reduce operational costs. Congress has directed federal agencies to increase their use of uncrewed marine systems (UMSs) as a cost-cutting measure. While deploying a UMS may cost less than deploying an oceanographic research vessel, some UMSs would need to be deployed from a vessel. Congress also may be interested in understanding how the size, capabilities, and utilization of the U.S. oceanographic research fleet compare to the fleets of foreign governments (e.g., the People’s Republic of China [PRC] and/or Russia). Some Members of Congress are concerned about the PRC’s expanding global deployment of its state-owned fleet of oceanographic research vessels. Several stakeholders have expressed concerns about how data collected by PRC oceanographic research vessels may present national security concerns, as these data have numerous applications, including for military use. Congress could examine whether the current U.S. oceanographic research fleet is capable of collecting these types of data and whether the United States should consider oceanographic research vessels for national security objectives, in addition to research activities. Such an examination may elucidate congressional priorities for the renewal of the federal oceanographic research fleet. Download the document here .

中国人民解放军 (PLA) 拥有一支日益多样化的直升机机队，涵盖从基本飞行员训练和战场运输到空中预警、反潜战和专门攻击任务等各个领域。这支部队反映了数十年的发展，通常从从法国购买直升机开始，后来经许可生产，然后逐渐转向本土设计。其结果是，经过大规模现代化改造的旧飞机和根据中国不断扩大的军事需求而设计的新型平台，包括不断壮大的航母和两栖攻击舰队。 Z-10 攻击直升机。摄影：VCG/VCG via Getty Images Z-8 系列最初源自冷战时期的法国 Super Frelon，是这种演变的一个特别好的例子。它催生了各种专门的变体，包括搜索和救援、运输、电子战和机载指挥所直升机。与此同时，Z-20（经常被称为西科斯基 S-70/H-60 克隆版）已成为具有陆基、海军和攻击型的现代中型运输平台，而 Z-10 和更新的 Z-21 则代表了中国对专用攻击直升机的日益重视。 2024 年，中国南方广东省珠海市的珠海航展上，一架 Z-8C 飞机进行空中攻击演示。
CFOTO/Future Publishing via Getty Images 本指南探讨了解放军运营的主要直升机类型、它们的发展以及它们预期发挥的作用。同时，应该指出的是，就目前情况而言，解放军在各种应用中仍然严重依赖外国采购的直升机。俄罗斯制造的直升机为解放军提供了运输和特种海军能力的结合。 Mi-17/171 Hip 系列支持部队和货物运输、搜索和救援、特种作战以及选择高空或特定任务角色。在海上，Ka-28 Helix 提供反潜战能力，而 Ka-31 的雷达则支持机载舰队监视。这些飞机仍在服役，其既定能力继续满足作战需求。然而，它们越来越多地得到中国设计的补充，包括某些专门为提供直接替代品而定制的设计。解放军运营的最先进的直升机是用于战斗搜索和救援的 Mi-171Sh。它具有广泛的自我保护设备和武器。摄影：Sun Lin/VCG via Getty Images 实用、训练和轻型直升机 HC-120 HC-120 是一款轻型通用直升机，源自 EC120，EC120 是中国、法国和新加坡在 20 世纪 90 年代共同开发的设计。
该型号于 2005 年进入解放军陆军航空兵服役，为初级直升机训练提供了现代化平台，并取代了老化的 SA316 Alouette III。HC-120 由一台透博梅卡 Arrius 2F 涡轮轴发动机提供动力。它的推出代表了陆军航空训练机队现代化的重要一步，为飞行员在过渡到更大的作战类型之前提供了使用更现代的直升机的经验。一架 HC-120，采用陆军航空训练学校的颜色。来自中国互联网 Z-11 Z-11 是由昌河飞机工业公司（CHAIC）和 602 研究所开发的轻型通用直升机。该设计基于法国 AS350BA Écureuil ，其示例来自于

【原文 English Original】
China’s People’s Liberation Army (PLA) operates an increasingly diverse fleet of helicopters spanning everything from basic pilot training and battlefield transport to airborne early warning, anti-submarine warfare, and dedicated attack missions. The force reflects decades of development, often beginning with helicopters acquired from France and later produced under license, before transitioning to increasingly indigenous designs. The result is a mix of older aircraft that have undergone extensive modernization and newer platforms designed around the requirements of China’s expanding military, including its growing carrier and amphibious assault fleets . A Z-10 attack helicopter. Photo by VCG/VCG via Getty Images The Z-8 family, originally derived from the Cold War-era French Super Frelon , is a particularly good example of this evolution. It has spawned a wide range of specialized variants, including search and rescue, transport, electronic warfare, and airborne command post helicopters. Meanwhile, the Z-20 — frequently alluded to as a Sikorsky S-70/H-60 clone — has emerged as a modern medium-lift platform with land-based, naval, and assault variants, while the Z-10 and newer Z-21 represent China’s growing emphasis on dedicated attack helicopters. A PLAN Z-8C conducts an aerial assault demonstration at the Zhuhai Air Show in Zhuhai, south China’s Guangdong province, in 2024. CFOTO/Future Publishing via Getty Images This guide examines the principal helicopter types operated by the PLA, their development, and the roles they are expected to perform. At the same time, it should be noted that, as it now stands, the PLA remains heavily reliant on foreign-sourced helicopters for a wide variety of applications. Russian-built helicopters give the PLA a mix of transport and specialized naval capabilities. The Mi-17/171 Hip family supports troop and cargo movement, search and rescue, special operations, and select high-altitude or mission-specific roles. At sea, the Ka-28 Helix provides anti-submarine warfare, while the Ka-31’s radar supports airborne fleet surveillance. These aircraft remain in service where their established capabilities continue to meet operational needs. However, they are increasingly supplemented by Chinese designs, including certain designs that have been tailored to provide direct replacements. The most advanced Hip helicopter operated by the PLA is the Mi-171Sh used for combat search and rescue. It features extensive self-protection equipment and armament. Photo by Sun Lin/VCG via Getty Images Utility, Training, and Light Helicopters HC-120 The HC-120 is a light utility helicopter derived from the EC120, a design co-developed by China, France, and Singapore during the 1990s. The type entered service with PLA Army Aviation in 2005, providing a modern platform for primary helicopter training and replacing the aging SA316 Alouette III in that role. The HC-120 is powered by a single Turbomeca Arrius 2F turboshaft engine. Its introduction represented an important step in modernizing the Army Aviation training fleet, giving pilots experience with a more contemporary helicopter before transitioning to larger operational types. An HC-120 in the colors of the Army Aviation Training School. via Chinese internet Z-11 The Z-11 is a light utility helicopter developed by Changhe Aircraft Industries Corporation (CHAIC) and the 602 Research Institute. The design is based on the French AS350BA Écureuil , examples of which were acquired for Army Aviation. Deliveries of the Z-11 to Army Aviation began in 1998. The helicopter is powered by a single WZ-8D turboshaft engine and is primarily used for training, liaison, and other light utility duties. A scout and armed reconnaissance derivative, designated as the Z-11WB, was developed with a nose-mounted electro-optical (EO) turret and external weapon pylons capable of carrying rockets, missiles, and gun pods. Its operational status remains unclear, although it provided the basis for the unarmed Z-11A training helicopter used by the Army Aviation Academy. A demonstrator for the Z-11WB scout and armed reconnaissance helicopter. via Chinese internet The Z-8 Family: From French Origins To A Modern Helicopter Lineage Z-8J The Z-8 was developed from the French SA321Ja Super Frelon, 13 examples of which China purchased during the late 1970s. Changhe Aircraft Industries Corporation subsequently developed an indigenous version during the 1980s. Powered by three WZ-6 turboshaft engines, the original Z-8 became the foundation for a broad family of helicopters serving the PLA Navy (PLAN), Army Aviation, and People’s Liberation Army Air Force (PLAAF). The Z-8J is the naval transport variant, with a boat-like hull. For anti-submarine warfare (ASW) missions, the helicopter can be equipped with a surface-search radar, a French HS-12 dipping sonar, and Whitehead A244S or ET52 torpedoes. Several specialized derivatives were developed from the Z-8J: Z-8S: A naval search and rescue (SAR) version with upgraded avionics, a searchlight, a forward-looking infrared (FLIR) turret, and a rescue hoist. Most Z-8Js have reportedly been upgraded to this configuration. Z-8JH: A medical evacuation and SAR variant. The Z-8J and Z-8JH have both been used aboard Chinese aircraft carriers, providing transport and support capabilities for embarked naval forces. A Z-8JH on the PLAN replenishment ship Kekexilihu at Qingdao Port, Shandong Province of China, in 2023. Photo by Fu Tian/China News Service/VCG via Getty Images Z-8C The Z-8C represents a substantially improved successor to the original naval Z-8J series. The helicopter was first reported in 2016 and incorporates a number of changes intended to improve its performance and operational versatility. The most visible differences include a redesigned nose with a chin-mounted weather radar, a FLIR turret, and a pilot night-vision system (PNVS) mounted above the cockpit. A searchlight is also fitted, while the longer engine compartment accommodates the WZ-6C turboshaft engine. The Z-8C is operated by the PLA Marine Corps, while the Z-8CJ serves as a training variant with the Naval Aviation University. The helicopter has become a principal transport platform for the Type 075 amphibious assault ship, supporting the movement of troops and equipment between ships and shore. Z-8C helicopters conduct aerial display training for the upcoming Airshow China in Zhuhai, Guangdong Province of China, in 2024. Photo by Chen Xiao/VCG via Getty Images Z-8K/KA The PLAAF introduced the Z-8K in 2007 as a dedicated search-and-rescue helicopter. The related Z-8KA is configured for combat search and rescue (CSAR), including the recovery of personnel from hostile or contested environments. Both versions feature a FLIR turret, searchlight, radar-warning receiver (RWR), chaff and flare dispensers, and a rescue hoist. Some aircraft are also equipped with small terrain-following radars beneath the nose to support low-level operations. Selected helicopters have received satellite communications (SATCOM) antennas on top of the tail boom, improving their communications capabilities over longer distances. A further derivative, the Z-8KH, was developed for the PLAAF garrison stationed in Hong Kong. This version is distinguished by chaff and flare dispensers integrated into its flotation equipment. A Z-8KA helicopter during the 2022 Changchun Air Show at Changchun Dafangshen Airport, Jilin Province of China. Photo by VCG/VCG via Getty Images Z-8B The Z-8B entered service with PLA Army Aviation in 2011 as an improved transport helicopter. It shares several characteristics with the Z-8KH but lacks the latter’s flotation equipment. The Z-8B incorporates a glass cockpit and has become a major component of the Army Aviation transport fleet. Some aircraft have subsequently had flotation equipment reinstalled, reflecting the type’s continuing evolution. An optional auxiliary fuel tank can be installed inside the cabin to extend its range. Other upgrades have included SATCOM antennas on the tail boom and, on some aircraft, WZ-6C engines, an EO turret, and a terrain-following radar beneath the nose. A specialized operations variant has also been identified. These helicopters incorporate RWR, laser-warning receivers (LWR), and missile-approach warning system (MAWS) sensors, alongside flare dispensers and ceramic armor protection. A still from a CCTV video shows a Z-8B equipped with RWR, LWR, and MAWS sensors, as well as countermeasures dispensers. via Chinese internet Z-8G Lacking the boat-like hull of the Z-8B, the Z-8G is expected to replace that type in Army Aviation service. The helicopter was evaluated from 2014 and was specifically optimized for operations at high altitudes, including in Tibet. Unlike earlier Z-8 variants, the initial Z-8G configuration uses imported Pratt & Whitney Canada PT6B-67A turboshaft engines. Its redesigned nose is longer and more aerodynamically efficient, while the glass cockpit and terrain-following radar support operations in demanding environments. The helicopter also incorporates SATCOM and BeiDou/GPS antennas to improve communications and navigation during long-range missions. Some Z-8Gs have been equipped for special operations, with combinations of MAWS, RWR, and LWR sensors mounted on the rear fuselage and sponsons, together with chaff and flare dispensers. Armor plates beneath the cockpit windows provide additional protection, and some aircraft carry a 12.7mm machine gun inside a cabin doorway. Several specialized variants have also been identified: A battlefield electronic-warfare helicopter featuring large cylindrical antennas mounted on both sides of the mid-fuselage. Another electronic warfare configuration reportedly uses rectangular plate antenna arrays mounted on both sides of the rear fuselage. An airborne command-post variant featuring a retractable synthetic-aperture radar (SAR) surveillance system inside the rear fuselage, alongside additional electronic-support-measures (ESM) antennas. Some Z-8Gs may also have adopted the indigenous WZ-6C engine. A Z-8G at Airshow China at Zhuhai in 2024. Photo by Costfoto/NurPhoto via Getty Images Z-8L The Z-8L is a wide-body development of the Z-8G that first flew in 2017. Its most prominent feature is a pair of large sponsons mounted along the sides of the fuselage, providing additional space for fuel tanks and other equipment. The wider fuselage also increases internal volume, allowing the helicopter to carry more cargo and equipment. Relocating the internal fuel tanks beneath the cabin floor has further increased usable cabin space. Some aircraft have been observed with RWR and MAWS sensors on both sides of the forward fuselage, a roof-mounted FLIR turret, and a terrain-following radar beneath the nose. Additional defensive equipment, including LWR and RWR sensors and chaff/flare dispensers, can be installed on the sponsons. A SATCOM antenna is mounted on top of the tail boom. The original PT6B-67A engines are reportedly being replaced by the more powerful indigenous WZ-7 turboshaft. The Z-8L provides the Army with a larger and more capable transport helicopter suited to demanding operating environments and specialized missions. A Z-8L (nearest camera) alongside a Z-20 during the 2022 Airshow China in Zhuhai, Guangdong province of China. Photo by Stringer/Anadolu Agency via Getty Images Z-8D The Z-8D is a shipborne derivative of the Z-8L that first appeared in 2023. It combines the wide-body configuration with an extensive self-defense suite intended to improve survivability during operations over water. The helicopter features RWR, LWR, and MAWS sensors, along with chaff and flare dispensers. Four inflatable flotation units provide emergency protection in the event of a forced landing at sea. Power is supplied by either WZ-6C or the newer WZ-7 turboshaft engines. Engine air particle separators (EAPS) are installed ahead of the engine inlets to reduce the risk of damage from airborne debris. The Z-8D is expected to operate from China’s Type 075 amphibious assault ships and the larger Type 076 amphibious assault ship. One of the first clear images of a PLAN Naval Aviation Z-8D. via Chinese internet The Z-18 Series: Naval Utility, Early Warning, and ASW Helicopters Z-18Y Named White Heron, the Z-18Y was developed by the 602 Research Institute and Changhe as a new medium-lift shipborne transport helicopter. It is derived from the AC313 but incorporates a redesigned fuselage and a number of changes intended to improve its naval suitability. The helicopter uses imported PT6B-67A turboshaft engines and provides greater internal volume and payload capacity than the earlier Z-8. Improved performance in hot-and-high conditions is another important feature. The Z-18Y incorporates a nose-mounted weather radar and an FLIR/TV turret, along with additional communication and navigation antennas beneath the fuselage. A SATCOM antenna is installed on top of the tail boom. Folding main and tail rotor blades allow the helicopter to be stored more efficiently aboard ships. The Z-18Y is primarily used for carrier onboard delivery (COD) missions, transporting personnel and supplies between ships and shore. It has also provided the basis for several specialized naval derivatives. A Z-18Y operating from a Type 075 class assault ship. PLA Z-18J Named Bat, the Z-18J is an airborne early warning and control (AEW&C) helicopter developed from the Z-18Y. Its principal feature is a retractable radar antenna housed within a redesigned rear fuselage. The long-range, multimode AESA radar is lowered vertically during operation, providing 360-degree coverage around the helicopter. The Z-18J also incorporates a nose-mounted FLIR turret and additional MAWS and RWR antennas distributed around the nose and rear fuselage. Chaff and flare dispensers are installed in the flotation equipment. The helicopter has been used aboard Chinese aircraft carriers as an interim airborne early-warning platform and has also been observed operating from Type 075 amphibious assault ships. A rescue hoist is installed on the starboard side of the forward fuselage, allowing the aircraft to perform secondary SAR duties. An improved Z-18A features a redesigned engine and gearbox compartment and three indigenous WZ-6C engines. Some Z-18Js and Z-18As have also received SATCOM antennas to improve long-range communications. A Z-18J together with two J-15 fighters onboard the Liaoning . via Chinese internet Z-18F Named Sea Eagle, the Z-18F is an ASW and anti-ship warfare helicopter developed from the Z-18Y. It first appeared in 2014 and represents a substantial improvement over the earlier Z-8-based naval ASW helicopters. The helicopter incorporates a large surface-search radar beneath the nose, while its FLIR/TV turret has been relocated to the starboard side of the fuselage. A dipping sonar provides an additional means of detecting submarines, while MAWS and RWR antennas are installed on the forward and rear fuselage. Additional communications and navigation antennas are mounted beneath the fuselage. Four external pylons can carry torpedoes or anti-ship missiles (AShMs), including the YJ-9. A dispenser near the rear loading ramp allows the helicopter to deploy sonobuoys. The Z-18F operates aboard Chinese aircraft carriers and the Type 075 amphibious assault ship. Several improved derivatives have since appeared: Z-18FA: Incorporates a redesigned engine and gearbox compartment and three domestic WZ-6C turboshaft engines. Z-18FG: Features a new chin-mounted search radar and small side pylons for lightweight ASW torpedoes or AShMs. Z-18FB: A further improved version reportedly powered by three WZ-7 turboshaft engines, replacing the Canadian PT6B-67A. These developments point to a continuing effort to improve the Z-18’s performance and extend the operational life of the broader family. A Z-18F assigned to the aircraft carrier Liaoning . via Chinese internet The Z-9 Family Z-9A/B The Z-9 originated from the French AS365 Dauphin family, with China acquiring aircraft and subsequently producing them under license through Harbin Aircraft Industry Group (HAIG) during the 1990s. The Z-9A became a principal utility helicopter for Army Aviation and was also used for pilot training. The improved Z-9B incorporated a greater proportion of indigenous components, helping establish the foundation for China’s broader Z-9 development program, which also took it in a maritime direction. The helicopter has since become one of China’s most widely used light utility platforms and has also been widely exported in the Z-9E series. Cambodian soldiers stand in front of Z-9s during a handover ceremony at a Royal Cambodian Air Force base in Phnom Penh, in 2013. KHEM SOVANNARA/AFP via Getty Images KHEM SOVANNARA Z-9C The Z-9C is China’s indigenous naval derivative of the French AS565 Panther , examples of which were imported during the late 1980s. The helicopter incorporates a domestically developed surface-search radar and dipping sonar, allowing it to conduct ASW missions. It can carry up to two Yu-7K torpedoes and is equipped with inflatable flotation bags for emergency landings on water. Some Z-9Cs have been converted to SAR duties, receiving a searchlight, an EO turret, and a rescue hoist. The type has also been used for anti-piracy patrols off the Somali coast. In this role, some aircraft have carried a 12.7mm gun pod and a 57mm rocket launcher. A downgraded training version was developed for the Naval Aviation Academy. Z-9 sits aboard the Type 052D destroyer Zhanjiang at Ngong Shuen Chau Naval Base on Stonecutters Island in Hong Kong on July 6, 2025. Photo by AFP Z-9D The Z-9D is an improved derivative of the Z-9C, incorporating a greater emphasis on anti-surface warfare. The helicopter features stub wings capable of carrying up to four AShMs for use against smaller surface targets. A new fire-control radar is housed in a larger nose cone, while the weapon-control officer is positioned in the rear cabin. RWR antennas are installed on both sides of the nose and near the tail rotor. The Z-9D has been observed operating from Type 056 and Type 056A frigates. Some aircraft have also received an EO turret beneath the fuselage, expanding their surveillance and targeting capabilities. A Z-9D carrying a YJ-9 anti-ship missile. via Chinese internet Z-9F The Z-9F is an improved ASW helicopter based on the Z-9D. It was first observed in 2017 and is expected to replace the older Z-9C. The helicopter incorporates a new dipping sonar, a glass cockpit, and an improved surface-search radar. A BeiDou antenna is mounted on top of the cabin. The Z-9F retains the ability to carry up to two ASW torpedoes beneath its stub wings, providing a more modern platform for shipborne submarine-hunting missions. Z-9S The Z-9S is a naval search-and-rescue helicopter developed for operations aboard Chinese aircraft carriers. It features a nose-mounted EO turret, a searchlight, and a rescue hoist installed on the starboard side. The helicopter is also used for training by the Naval Aviation University. A small number of SAR-configured Z-9S helicopters are also operated by Army Aviation. A Z-9S conducts exercises onboard a Type 055 destroyer. via Chinese internet Z-9WA/WZ The Z-9WA is a night-attack development of the Z-9W, incorporating more powerful engines and improved avionics for operations in low-light conditions. The helicopter features stub wings capable of carrying up to eight KD-8 anti-tank guided missiles (ATGMs) or PL-90 air-to-air missiles (AAMs). A nose-mounted low-light TV/IR turret supports night operations, while RWR antennas are installed on both sides of the fuselage. Additional features include cockpit armor, flare dispensers, a datalink, and a redesigned cockpit compatible with night-vision goggles (NVGs). Z-9WZ. via Chinese internet The improved Z-9WZ incorporates a laser designator, allowing it to employ the newer KD-9 ATGM, as well as FN-6 AAMs. It is also powered by WZ-8H engines. Most Z-9WAs are believed to have been upgraded to the WZ standard. The PLAAF operates some Z-9WA/WZ helicopters in the SAR role. A similar derivative, the Z-9ZH, is used by the PLAAF garrison stationed in Hong Kong. Dedicated Attack and Scout Helicopters Z-10 The Z-10 represents China’s first dedicated modern attack helicopter. Developed by the 602 Research Institute, CHAIC, and HAIG, the program also received early input from Russia’s Kamov design bureau. The helicopter features a conventional tandem-seat gunship configuration, with the gunner seated in front and the pilot behind. A five-blade composite main rotor and distinctive scissor-type tail rotor distinguish the design. The Z-10 is powered by WZ-9 turboshaft engines and entered service in 2010, following its first flight in 2003. A Z-10K at the Shek Kong Barracks in Hong Kong, China. Photo by Zhang Xiangyi/China News Service/VCG via Getty Images Its primary armament consists of up to eight KD-9 or KD-10 laser-guided ATGMs, supplemented by a chin-mounted 23mm chain gun. The helicopter can also carry up to eight PL-90 AAMs. The nose-mounted PNVS and target acquisition and designation system (TADS)-equivalent housing incorporates FLIR, a TV camera, a laser rangefinder, and a laser designator. RWR antennas are installed on both sides of the forward and aft fuselage, while LWR sensors are mounted on the pylon tips. The initial prototypes were powered by the Pratt & Whitney Canada PT6C-76C engine. Series-production aircraft instead adopted the less powerful WZ-9, resulting in reductions to armor protection, sensor size, and weapon load compared with the original configuration. Several variants and upgrades have since emerged: Z-10H: Retains the original PNVS/TADS configuration while using WZ-9 engines. Z-10K: A dedicated version for PLAAF airborne units, featuring a new 23mm gun and 19-tube rocket launchers. Some aircraft have SATCOM antennas on top of the tail boom. Z-10A: The definitive production configuration, distinguished by upward-facing engine exhaust nozzles. Later upgrades: Some Z-10 and Z-10K aircraft have received additional ceramic armor, MAWS sensors on the nose, and SATCOM antennas for long-range communications. The helicopter has also gained newer long-range, IIR/CCD-guided ATGMs. These weapons require an additional datalink antenna mounted in front of the PNVS. Later developments include the introduction of millimeter-wave (MMW) radar-guided fire-and-forget missiles, potentially allowing the Z-10 to operate alongside the Z-19 in coordinated attack missions. The export-oriented Z-10ME incorporates further improvements, including a mast-mounted MMW radar. Z-19 The Z-19 is a scout and attack helicopter developed by HAIG using the H425 as its basis. It was intended to replace the Z-9WA while complementing the larger Z-10. The helicopter features a narrow fuselage and tandem cockpit, with the pilot seated in front and the gunner behind. A nose-mounted EO turret incorporates FLIR, a TV camera, and a laser rangefinder, while RWR antennas provide warning of hostile radar emissions. The Z-19 uses the same WZ-8C engines, transmission, and rotor systems as the H425, helping accelerate its development. A Z-19 without the mast-mounted MMW radar. via Chinese internet When fitted with a mast-mounted MMW radar, the Z-19 provides additional target-detection capabilities. The helicopter’s armament is broadly similar to that of the Z-9WA, including KD-9 and KD-10 ATGMs, PL-90 AAMs, rocket launchers, and gun pods. Later upgrades include MAWS sensors on the nose and tail, along with LWR sensors on the stub wings. The Z-19 has also been integrated with newer long-range IIR/CCD/laser-guided ATGMs, including the KF-9, KF-10, and KF-11. These weapons require an additional datalink antenna mounted on the nose. Z-21 The Z-21 is a new heavy attack helicopter first identified in 2024. Developed by the 602 Research Institute, Changhe, and Hafei, it appears to be a substantially larger and more heavily protected gunship than the Z-10. The helicopter is believed to use the WZ-10 turboshaft engines and rotor systems developed for the Z-20. It features a conventional tandem-seat configuration, with a gunner in the front and a pilot behind. One of the first photos of the Z-21. via Chinese internet Large cheek fairings on either side of the fuselage incorporate MAWS, LWR, ESM, and electronic countermeasures (ECM) equipment. The nose features a new PNVS above a TADS, while an MMW search radar is mounted above the main rotor mast. Laser-powered directional infrared countermeasures (DIRCM) are installed on the wingtips. Additional defensive equipment includes chaff and flare dispensers on the cheek fairings and tail boom. A BeiDou antenna is mounted on the tail boom, while at least one prototype has been observed with upward-facing engine exhausts. Z-21. via Chinese internet The Z-21 is expected to feature a 30mm chain gun beneath the forward fuselage. Each stub wing incorporates three weapon stations capable of carrying the newer KF-series long-range ATGMs, PL-90 AAMs, and other emerging weapons. Compared with the Z-20, the Z-21 is expected to offer improved high-altitude performance, greater armor protection, and a heavier payload, making it better suited to demanding attack missions. The Z-20 Family: China’s New Medium Helicopter Z-20 The Z-20 is China’s new medium-lift general-purpose helicopter, developed by the 602 Research Institute, Harbin, and Changhe since the late 1990s. The design is heavily influenced by the Sikorsky S-70 Black Hawk , examples of which China acquired for the PLA during the 1980s. However, the Z-20 incorporates a number of indigenous systems and is intended to replace the Mi-17 series in Army Aviation service. The helicopter features a five-blade main rotor, a glass cockpit, and armor protection around the cockpit. A PNVS is mounted beneath the chin, while RWR antennas are installed on both sides of the forward and rear fuselage. Additional equipment includes LWR sensors on both sides of the nose, SATCOM, ECM antennas on top of the fuselage, and a nose-mounted weather radar and terrain-following radar. A Z-20 during the 7th China Helicopter Exposition in Tianjin Municipality, China, in 2025. Photo by VCG/VCG via Getty Images The Z-20 is powered by two WZ-10 turboshaft engines and can carry up to 13 fully equipped soldiers. An optional fuel tank can be installed in the cargo compartment to extend its range. Stub wings can be fitted to carry rocket launchers, gun pods, and external fuel tanks. The Z-20 first flew in 2013 and entered service with PLA Army Aviation by 2019. Several aircraft have been observed with upward-facing engine exhausts. A SAR variant incorporates an EO turret and searchlight beneath the forward fuselage, together with a rescue hoist above the cabin door. Z-20K/KS/KT The Z-20 has also spawned a number of specialized variants for the PLAAF. The Z-20K, identified in 2022, is a transport helicopter intended for airborne assault units. The PLAAF operates the Z-20KS subvariant in the SAR role. This model features an EO turret and searchlight beneath the forward fuselage, while optional stub wings allow it to carry rocket launchers and gun pods. An improved assault variant, the Z-20KT, incorporates a larger SATCOM antenna on top of the tail boom. Its folding tail section indicates that the helicopter is designed to facilitate aerial transport, allowing rapid deployment over long distances. A Z-20K at the Shek Kong Barracks in Hong Kong, China, in 2026. Photo by VCG/VCG via Getty Images Z-20T The Z-20T is a specialized assault helicopter broadly comparable in concept to the MH-60L Direct Action Penetrator used by the U.S. Army. The helicopter features large stub wings capable of carrying KD-9 and KD-10 ATGMs, KF-9A ATGMs, PL-90 AAMs, ECM pods, and external fuel tanks. LWR sensors have been relocated to the wingtips, while a TADS has replaced the weather radar in the nose. Additional armor plates provide increased protection for the crew and critical systems. Later examples have also been observed with upward-facing engine exhausts. Air Cavalry: Footage shows Z-20T assault helicopters effectively boosting the tactical flexibility of the Chinese PLA Army’s heliborne troops during an air assault training exercise. #Helicopter #AirAssault #Z20T #Z10 #PLA #Army #ChinaMilitary #ChinaMilBugle pic.twitter.com/NcoMbsz9gP — China Military Bugle (@ChinaMilBugle) May 1, 2026 Z-20F The Z-20F is a shipborne ASW helicopter developed to provide the PLAN with a modern equivalent to the MH-60R Seahawk . It first flew in 2018. The helicopter incorporates folding rotor blades and a folding tail boom to facilitate shipboard storage. An emergency flotation system is fitted, while the rear landing gear has been relocated forward to the rear end of the fuselage. The redesigned nose features an EO/laser-ranging turret, with a surface-search radar antenna mounted beneath the chin. A SATCOM antenna is installed on top of the tail boom. Additional ESM antennas are distributed around the nose and rear fuselage. A 25-round sonobuoy launcher is mounted on the port side, while a dipping sonar and rescue hoist provide additional ASW and SAR capabilities. The Z-20F can carry up to four YJ-9 AShMs beneath its stub wings, alongside lightweight ASW torpedoes on rear fuselage pylons. The helicopter is expected to replace the older Z-9C on Type 054 frigates and Type 052 and Type 055 destroyers. It has also been observed aboard the aircraft carrier Fujian and Type 075 amphibious assault ships. A Z-20F on the deck of the carrier Fujian carrying a pair of YJ-9 anti-ship missiles under one stub wing. via Chinese internet Z-20J The Z-20J is a shipborne transport and assault variant designed for the PLAN. Its stub wings can carry up to eight KD-9 ATGMs or four YJ-9 AShMs, as well as rocket launchers, external fuel tanks, and gun pods. MAWS sensors are installed on both sides of the chin and along the rear fuselage, providing additional protection during operations over water. The Z-20J expands the range of missions that can be performed from Chinese surface combatants and amphibious assault ships, complementing the ASW-focused Z-20F. Z-20J. via Chinese internet Conclusion Despite often being overshadowed by the PLA’s latest combat aircraft , missiles , and other high-profile weapons programs, helicopters remain an indispensable part of China’s military modernization. They provide critical capabilities, from moving troops and supplies across difficult terrain to supporting amphibious operations, special forces, search and rescue, and naval warfare. More importantly, the steady development of indigenous helicopter designs reflects China’s determination to reduce reliance on foreign suppliers and build a more capable, self-sufficient rotary-wing force. These aircraft may attract less attention than the PLA’s newest fighters, but their growing sophistication and expanding roles make them an essential part of the force’s ability to operate across a wide range of contingencies. Contact the author: thomas@thewarzone.com The post A Guide To China’s Expanding Fleet Of Military Helicopters appeared first on TWZ .

title: 黃之鋒勾結境外勢力危害國安罪成 判入獄10年 法官指「罪行重大」
summary: 追光者報道 因民主派初選47人案服刑的前香港眾志秘書長黃之鋒，早前承認一項「串謀勾結外國或者境外勢力危害國家安全」罪，案件今（5日）在高等法院判刑，黃之鋒被判入獄10年。黃自2020年11月起因其他案件一直還押，在獄中已接近6年。法官指在評估罪行的嚴重程度，須整體考慮案情，法庭認為本案屬「罪行重大」。 黃之鋒今日步入法庭時，戴着黑框眼鏡，手拿筆記和一本書，在犯人欄坐下後向旁聽的公眾人士點頭，並做出OK的手勢。法官強調，黃之鋒並非因《國安法》生效前的行為或政治理念而被判刑，在法
content: 追光者報道 因民主派初選47人案服刑的前香港眾志秘書長黃之鋒，早前承認一項「串謀勾結外國或者境外勢力危害國家安全」罪，案件今（5日）在高等法院判刑，黃之鋒被判入獄10年。黃自2020年11月起因其他案件一直還押，在獄中已接近6年。法官指在評估罪行的嚴重程度，須整體考慮案情，法庭認為本案屬「罪行重大」。 黃之鋒今日步入法庭時，戴着黑框眼鏡，手拿筆記和一本書，在犯人欄坐下後向旁聽的公眾人士點頭，並做出OK的手勢。法官強調，黃之鋒並非因《國安法》生效前的行為或政治理念而被判刑，在法例生效後黃之鋒及羅冠聰等人繼續共同履行協議，黃留港繼續支持「國際線」，包括在社交平台分享羅的帖文。而法例生效前的行為和活動，則構成罪行的背景。 法庭認為本案局「罪行重大」，案發時社會動盪、法治面臨重大風險，指黃之鋒和羅冠聰呼籲制裁，加劇港府及中國當時的處境。報道指黃之鋒聽到後表情平靜，繼續低頭抄寫筆記。 黃之鋒被控於2020年7月1日至11月23日間，在香港與羅冠聰及其他身分不詳的人串謀請求外國或者境外機構、組織、人員實施對香港特別行政區或者中華人民共和國制裁、封鎖或者採取其他敵對行動。並且在《國安法》實施前後，二人及香港眾志多次呼籲外國對香港特區及中國採取制裁或敵對措施，包括訪問外國、會見政界人士、參與聽證會、發起聯署，以及在社交媒體和外國媒體上倡議「國際線」。 案情又指多國針對中國及香港特區政府採取措施，包括美國通過《香港自治法案》、制裁政府官員及暫停部分協議，英國、德國、法國亦暫停與香港的引渡逃犯協議。 黃之鋒在2025年6月6日因本案被捕，當時他正在獄中就「47人案」而服刑。上月剛踏入30歲的黃之鋒自2020年11月起一直被囚。他於「47人案」被判入獄4年8個月，原預計明年1月出獄，而今次刑期為10年，其中2個月會與「47人案」同期執行，料最快2036年11月才能刑滿出獄。 國際人權組織持續關注案件 黃之鋒被控勾結境外勢力罪一直受到國際人權組織關注，有組織指出港府的指控在2020年取消他的參選資格時，同時指他勾結外國勢力，顯示其後針對他的《國安法》指控早在提出控罪前已決定。港府亦將對法治和人權狀況的監察，定性為對國家主權的攻擊。控方又將黃之鋒在國際的倡議活動，描述為促請外國實施制裁，卻刻意忽略他曾大力聲援2020年8月遭中國海警截獲及拘留的12名抗爭者，意圖抹去其人權背景。 而針對被捕和控罪時間點，案中所涉及的行為可追溯至2020年，但黃直至2025年6月才因相關案件被捕。當時他已就「初選47人案」服了大部分刑期。因此，人權組織認為當局在他預計於明年1月獲釋前夕，對他提出新的檢控。 香港眾志於2016年成立，而黃之鋒及羅冠聰分別曾任秘書長及創黨主席，至2020年6月30日該組織解散，羅冠聰其後離港。案情指黃之鋒在《國安法》生效前串謀勾結外國勢力的行為，黃之鋒、羅冠聰及香港眾志於2016年參與推動美國的《香港人權與民主法案》；2019年出席「美國國會及行政當局中國委員會」聽證會，提及該年社會運動狀況，要求重新審視美國給予香港的特殊待遇地位；同年與德國時任外交部長馬斯見面，促請德國延遲與中國和香港的貿易、停止向香港警察售武。 而在《國安法》生效後的行為包括黃在眾志解散後，在Facebook稱不會刪除舊文、不會放棄其政治立場和意見，亦不會放棄打「國際線」。而其身在海外的戰友，例如羅冠聰將繼續打「國際線」、代替因《國安法》而未能在港提出的主張，認為香港需要有人留守，在本地繼續抗爭、爭取國際社會和外媒關注。

title: North Korean Leader Inspects New Warship Under Construction at Nampho Shipyard
zh_title: 朝鲜领导人视察南浦造船厂正在建造的新军舰

content:
朝鲜领导人金正恩于 2026 年 11 月 2 日在南浦造船厂视察新军舰。官方媒体 朝鲜中央通讯社照片 据官方媒体周三报道，朝鲜领导人金正恩周一在访问朝鲜南浦造船厂期间，视察了一艘比该国 5000 吨级驱逐舰更大的新军舰的建造情况。这艘正在建造的军舰据信是一艘万吨级巡洋舰。官方媒体朝鲜中央通讯社（KCNA）发布的一张图片显示，金正恩和朝鲜官员在南浦造船厂的一艘船体前。所示的船体明显大于现役的两艘 5000 吨级崔贤级驱逐舰，后者是朝鲜目前最大的水面战舰。朝中社报道称：“金正恩同志看着正在建造的船只，对其庞大而雄伟的外观表示非常满意，这与去年建造的驱逐舰无法比拟。” 6 月 23 日，朝鲜领导人在 5000 吨级驱逐舰 Choe Hyon（51）的入役仪式上谈到了 10000 吨级巡洋舰。金正恩当时表示，朝鲜将“陆续”下水万吨级巡洋舰。朝鲜使用“战略”一词来描述核武器能力。据官方媒体朝中社 (KCNA) 报道，作为崔贤作战效率测试的一部分，2026 年 4 月 12 日发射了两枚战略巡航导弹和三枚反舰导弹。
朝中社照片 朝鲜尚未公布有关计划中的万吨级巡洋舰的细节。根据朝鲜2026-30年海军建设计划，该国将寻求每年建造两艘水面舰艇。与此同时，朝鲜计划建造护航舰艇和特种用途舰艇，并开发水下武器系统。金正恩在之前的讲话中表示，另外两艘崔贤级驱逐舰正在建造中，第三艘驱逐舰计划在朝鲜劳动党10月10日建党纪念日期间下水。朝鲜尚未就第三艘舰的下水发表任何公告。据朝中社报道，朝鲜领导人参观了南浦造船厂设施并发表讲话，他表示，加强朝鲜水面和水下海军部队的战斗力对于捍卫国家主权至关重要。他还表示，建设强大的海军力量，必须有先进、技术含量高的造船基地。金正恩指示造船厂在生产流程的各个环节实现自动化，增建水面船坞，形成同步造修船的能力，并纠正造船厂建筑布局中的不合理之处。他还呼吁造船厂招募更多人员进行船舶设计和建造。
朝鲜导弹管理局于 2026 年 11 月 4 日试射了一枚新设计的先进防空地对空导弹。官方媒体朝中社照片朝鲜最近进行了一系列武器试验，其中包括周六在战术弹道导弹上安装集束弹药弹头。朝中社在第二天的一份报告中称，弹道导弹系统研究所和导弹管理局弹头研究所宣布确认，标准2型集束炸弹弹头能够摧毁12-13公顷的目标区域。 “我们按照规定将集束炸弹弹头分为四类

【原文 English Original】
North Korean leader Kim Jong Un inspects new warship Nov. 2, 2026, at Nampho Shipyard. State media Korea Central News Agency photo North Korea leader Kim Jong Un inspected the ongoing construction of a new warship that is larger than the country’s 5,000-ton destroyers on Monday during a visit to North Korea’s Nampho Shipyard, state media reported Wednesday. The under-construction warship is believed to be a 10,000-ton cruiser. An image released by state media Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) shows Kim and North Korean officials in front of a ship hull at Nampho Shipyard. The hull shown is significantly larger than the two 5,000-ton Choe Hyon-class destroyers in service, which are currently North Korea’s largest surface warships. “Looking at the vessel under construction, Comrade Kim Jong Un expressed great satisfaction with its massive and imposing appearance, which was incomparable to the destroyer built last year,” reads the KCNA report. The North Korean leader spoke on June 23 of a 10,000-ton cruiser during the commissioning ceremony of 5,000-ton destroyer Choe Hyon (51). Kim said at the time that North Korea will launch 10,000-ton cruisers “one after another.” North Korea uses the term “strategic” to describe nuclear weapons capability. Two strategic cruise missiles and three anti-ship missiles were fired April 12, 2026, as part of Choe Hyon’s operational efficiency tests, state media Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) reported. Korean Central News Agency photo North Korea has released few details on the planned 10,000-ton cruiser. According to North Korea’s naval construction plan for 2026-30, the country will seek to build two surface ships annually. At the same time, North Korea plans to build escort ships and special purpose ships and develop underwater weapon systems. In previous speeches, Kim said two more Choe Hyon-class destroyers were under construction and that the third ship was scheduled to be launched in conjunction with the Oct. 10 anniversary of the ruling Workers’ Party of Korea. North Korea has not made any announcements regarding the launch of the third ship. The North Korean leader toured the Nampho Shipyard facilities and made a speech where he said that it was critical to strengthen the combat power of North Korea’s surface and underwater naval forces to defend national sovereignty, KCNA reported. He also said that in order to build a powerful naval force, there must be an advanced and highly technological shipbuilding base. Kim instructed the shipyard to implement automation in all elements of the production processes, construct an additional surface dock to create the capacity for simultaneous shipbuilding and repair and correct unreasonable aspects in the shipyard’s building layout. He also called on the shipyard to recruit additional personnel for ship design and construction. The North Korea Missile Administration test fired a newly-designed advanced air defense surface-to-air missile on Nov. 4, 2026. State media Korea Central News Agency photo North Korea recently conducted a series of weapons tests, including a cluster munitions warhead on a tactical ballistic missile on Saturday. In a report the following day, KCNA said the Ballistic Missile System Institute and the Warhead Institute of the Missile Administration announced confirmation that the Standard Type 2 cluster-bomb warhead is capable of devastating a target area of 12-13 hectares. “We classify the cluster-bomb warheads into four categories according to special and standard purposes. Within this year we will enable units to select and use all those types according to operational aims and specific features of targets,” said the Director General of the Missile Administration in the report. Saturday’s test was followed by a test on Monday. The Missile Administration evaluated a strategic cruise missile’s cluster warhead and conducted a vertical strike flight characteristics test of the cruise missile. The Warhead Institute of the Missile Administration said it confirmed that the medium-sized cluster warhead mounted on the cruise missile can completely devastate a target area of 5-6 hectares, KCNA reported. The Cruise Missile System Institute of the Missile Administration said that the test perfected the capability to deliver a vertical strike against the target by improving the terminal maneuverability of the cruise missile, taking into consideration the natural and geographical characteristics of the targeted area. The state media did not report the locations of the tests on Saturday and Monday. North Korea conducted a firepower demonstration exercise on Nov. 4, 2026. State media Korea Central News Agency photo On Wednesday, the Missile Administration test fired a newly-designed advanced air defense surface-to-air missile, KCNA reported Thursday. The test confirmed the technical specifications and reliability of the new material used for the missile and intelligent multiple guidance mode of the missile, target identification and tracking capability of the air-defence missile system and its detection information processing device. KCNA also reported Thursday that North Korea conducted a firepower demonstration exercise on Wednesday. The test was carried out by a sub-unit under the Eastern District Long-Range Strategic Cruise Missile Unit, with the sub-unit mobilized for the training successfully executing a strike mission against a simulated airfield target using long-range strategic cruise missiles. KCNA imagery released shows the target being a runway with aircraft mock-ups. South Korea’s Joint Chiefs of Staff on Wednesday said North Korea fired multiple missiles into the Sea of Japan from the Sondok area. South Korea and the United States are conducting a detailed analysis of the exact specifications of the detected North Korean missiles. “Our military is monitoring the North’s various movements under a robust South Korea-U.S. combined defense posture, and maintains the capabilities and readiness to respond overwhelmingly to any provocations,” the JCS said. U.S. Pacific Command issued the following statement on Wednesday: “We are aware of the missile launches by the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea on Nov. 4 (KST) and are consulting closely with our allies and partners. Based on current assessments, this event does not pose an immediate threat to U.S. personnel or territory, or to our allies. The United States remains committed to the defense of the U.S. homeland and our allies in the region.”

title: Hong Kong: Cruel Joshua Wong sentence a grim reminder of city’s disdain for human rights
zh_title: 香港：残酷的黄之锋判决严酷地提醒人们该城市对人权的蔑视
summary: 在回应香港活动人士黄之锋因“勾结外国势力”而被判处 10 年徒刑时，国际特赦组织区域副主任萨拉·布鲁克斯 (Sarah Brooks) 表示：“香港当局对黄之锋的迫害仍在继续，最新的国家安全定罪是残酷的——也许是故意的——就在他根据之前的定罪获得释放的几个月前。”黄之锋向权力讲真话的勇气值得赞扬，但在香港，让他成为一个罪犯。今天的这句话再次严峻地提醒我们
content:
在回应香港活动人士黄之锋因“勾结外国势力”而被判处 10 年徒刑时，国际特赦组织区域副主任萨拉·布鲁克斯 (Sarah Brooks) 表示：“香港当局对黄之锋的迫害仍在继续，最新的国家安全定罪是残酷的——也许是故意的——就在他根据之前的定罪获得释放的几个月前。”黄之锋向权力讲真话的勇气值得赞扬，但在香港，让他成为一个罪犯。今天的判决再次严峻地提醒人们，香港的国家安全法如何成为惩罚异议的工具，而不是真正保护国家安全的工具。 “国际社会不应接受继续将合法活动定罪为香港的新常态。各国政府必须继续施压，要求保护人权并释放那些仅仅因为行使权利而被监禁的人。国际特赦组织再次呼吁香港当局推翻黄之锋的国家安全定罪，并废除所有违反香港国际人权义务的立法。”背景 黄之锋今天根据北京实施的香港国家安全法（NSL）承认串谋外国势力罪名，被判处 10 年监禁。
根据第二次国家安全定罪，黄被指控在 2020 年 7 月至 2020 年 11 月期间与自我流亡的活动人士罗冠聪和“其他不明人士”合谋，要求外国或组织对香港或中国实施制裁、封锁或从事其他敌对活动。这位著名活动人士于 2024 年被判处四年零八个月的徒刑，这是《国家安全法》迄今为止最大规模的起诉，罪名是“串谋颠覆国家政权”。他是因参加 2020 年非官方“初选”而被监禁的 45 名反对派人士之一，联合国专家认为这些指控与受国际人权法保护的活动有关。此前的判决预计于 2027 年 1 月结束。自 2020 年以来，香港的人权状况急剧恶化，有 300 多人因违反《国家安全法》或殖民时代的“煽动叛乱”法而被捕。此外，地方当局于2024年推出的所谓“23条”立法进一步加深了镇压，压制了该市的反对声音。 《香港：残酷的黄之锋的判决，残酷地提醒人们香港对人权的蔑视》一文首先出现在国际特赦组织上。

【原文 English Original】
Responding to the 10-year sentence handed to Hong Kong activist Joshua Wong for “colluding with foreign forces”, Amnesty International’s Deputy Regional Director Sarah Brooks said: “The Hong Kong authorities’ persecution of Joshua Wong continues with this latest national security conviction, which cruelly – and perhaps deliberately – comes mere months before he would have been eligible for release under his previous conviction. “Joshua Wong’s bravery in speaking truth to power should be commended, but instead in Hong Kong it makes him a criminal. Today’s sentence is another grim reminder of how Hong Kong’s National Security Law has become a tool to punish dissent rather than to genuinely protect national security. “The international community should not accept the continued criminalization of legitimate activism as the new normal in Hong Kong. Governments must continue to press for the protection of human rights and the release of those imprisoned solely for exercising their rights. “Amnesty International reiterates its call on the Hong Kong authorities to overturn Joshua Wong’s national security convictions and to repeal all legislation that violates Hong Kong’s international human rights obligations.” Background Joshua Wong was today sentenced to 10 years in prison after pleading guilty to conspiring to collude with foreign forces under Hong Kong’s Beijing-imposed National Security Law (NSL). Under his second national security conviction, Wong was accused of conspiring with self-exiled activist Nathan Law and “other persons unknown” between July 2020 and November 2020 to request foreign countries or organizations to impose sanctions, blockades or engage in other hostile activities against Hong Kong or China. The prominent activist had been sentenced in 2024, in the largest mass prosecution under the NSL to date, to four years and eight months for “conspiracy to commit subversion”. He was one of 45 opposition figures jailed due to their participation in unofficial “primaries” in 2020, on charges which UN experts considered to relate to activities protected under international human rights law. This previous sentence is scheduled to end in January 2027. Hong Kong’s human rights situation has deteriorated dramatically since 2020, with more than 300 people arrested for violating the NSL or a colonial-era “sedition” law. In addition, the so-called Article 23 legislation introduced by the local authorities in 2024 has further deepened repression and silenced opposition voices in the city. The post Hong Kong: Cruel Joshua Wong sentence a grim reminder of city’s disdain for human rights appeared first on Amnesty International .

summary: 香港：人权组织谴责对黄之锋的不公正判决 zevans@freedom… 星期四，11/05/2026 - 15:23 键入联合声明 国家香港页面屏蔽 我们，以下签名组织，谴责香港高等法院 11 月 5 日对香港民主倡导者黄之锋判处 10 年徒刑。这是他第二次根据北京实施的国家安全法被判刑，该法导致香港的基本自由迅速恶化。三周前，约书亚在监狱里度过了自己的 30 岁生日，现在他晋升为承诺
content:
香港：人权组织谴责对黄之锋的不公正判决 zevans@freedom… 星期四，11/05/2026 - 15:23 输入联合声明 国家香港页面屏蔽 我们，以下签名组织，谴责香港高等法院 11 月 5 日对香港民主倡导者黄之锋判处 10 年徒刑。这是他第二次根据北京实施的国家安全法被判刑，该法导致香港的基本自由迅速恶化。三周前，约书亚在监狱里度过了自己的 30 岁生日，十几岁时，他作为学生团体学民思潮的联合创始人而声名鹊起，该团体反对将亲北京的宣传引入香港学校。他帮助领导了 2014 年历史性的雨伞运动，并于 2016 年创建了亲民主的众志党，该党在 2020 年《国家安全法》获得批准后被迫解散。他因其民主行动主义而获得国际赞誉，包括多次获得诺贝尔和平奖提名。由于这种宣传，约书亚一再入狱，自2020年11月以来一直被拘留。2024年，他因参加第一次也是唯一一次全市民主初选而被以阴谋颠覆罪判处四年零八个月监禁。
他预计将于 2027 年 1 月获释，但在 2025 年 6 月面临额外指控，罪名是因之前的活动而与外国势力合谋。 作为这些指控的一部分，检察官提到了约书亚与美国政府官员（包括当时的参议员马可·卢比奥）的会面。这是中国共产党一系列令人担忧的尝试之一，不仅限制和控制中国公民和香港人可以会见哪些人，还限制和控制外国政府官员可以联系谁以及他们可以收到哪些信息。此外，北京支持的香港政府强烈劝阻居民观看并考虑对获奖纪录片《约书亚：青少年与超级大国》采取进一步行动，该片记录了约书亚早期的活动，进一步表明其压制香港民主运动独立报道的努力。约书亚的拘留也凸显了中共如何继续藐视《中英联合声明》。该条约是 1997 年香港主权移交过程​​中谈判达成的，其中规定了“一国两种制度”的原则，该原则本应持续到 2047 年。中共对这一原则的漠视——约书亚因行使基本自由而被拘留就证明了这一点——令人质疑中共在贸易或其他问题上谈判达成的协议是否会得到遵守。
我们呼吁香港当局立即无条件释放约书亚，并要求民主政府更有力地要求释放他。具体来说，我们要求白宫和国务院承诺在唐纳德·特朗普总统和中国领导人习近平即将举行的双边会晤中提出约书亚的案件并呼吁释放他，特别是在我们即将于11月在深圳举行的亚太经合组织（APEC）会议和12月在佛罗里达州举行的20国集团（G20）峰会之际。特朗普政府在优先释放世界各地政治犯方面做了值得称赞的工作。政治犯金明日牧师从中国拘留所获释

Hong Kong: Human Rights Organizations Condemn Unjust Sentencing of Joshua Wong zevans@freedom… Thu, 11/05/2026 - 15:23 Type Joint Statement Countries Hong Kong Page blocks We, the undersigned organizations, condemn the November 5th sentencing of Hong Kong prodemocracy advocate Joshua Wong to a 10-year sentence by the Hong Kong High Court. This is the second time he has been sentenced under the Beijing-imposed National Security Law (NSL), which has contributed to the rapid deterioration of basic freedoms in Hong Kong. Joshua, who marked his 30th birthday in prison three weeks ago, rose to prominence as a teenager as the cofounder of the student group Scholarism, which opposed the introduction of pro-Beijing propaganda into Hong Kong's schools. He helped lead the historic 2014 Umbrella Movement and in 2016 created the prodemocracy Demosistō party, which was forced to disband after the approval of the NSL in 2020. He has received international acclaim for his democratic activism, including multiple nominations for the Nobel Peace Prize. As a result of this advocacy, Joshua has been repeatedly imprisoned, and has been detained continuously since November 2020. In 2024, he was sentenced to four years and eight months’ imprisonment on charges of conspiracy to commit subversion in connection with him taking part in the first and only city-wide democratic primary. He was expected to be released in January 2027, but faced additional charges in June 2025 of conspiring to collude with foreign forces for his earlier activism. As part of these charges, prosecutors referred to meetings that Joshua had with US government officials, including then Senator Marco Rubio. This is among a worrying series of attempts by the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) to restrict and control not only who Chinese citizens and Hong Kongers may meet, but also who foreign government officials may contact and what information they can receive. Additionally, the Beijing-backed Hong Kong government is strongly discouraging residents from viewing and considering further action on the award-winning documentary Joshua: Teenager vs. Superpower, which chronicles Joshua's early activism, further demonstrating its efforts to suppress independent accounts of Hong Kong's prodemocracy movement. Joshua's detention also highlights how the CCP continues to flout the Sino-British Joint Declaration. That treaty, negotiated as part of Hong Kong's 1997 handover, enshrines the "one country, two systems" principle that was supposed to prevail until 2047. The CCP's disregard for that principle—demonstrated by Joshua's detention for exercising his fundamental freedoms—calls into question whether deals the CCP negotiates on trade or other issues will be honored. We call on Hong Kong authorities to release Joshua immediately and unconditionally, and we ask that democratic governments more forcefully demand his release. Specifically, we request that the White House and the State Department commit to raising Joshua’s case and calling for his release in the upcoming bilateral meetings between President Donald Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping, particularly as we look to the upcoming Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) meeting in November in Shenzhen, and the Group of 20 (G20) Summit in Florida in December. The Trump administration has done a commendable job prioritizing the release of political prisoners around the world. The release of political prisoner Pastor Ezra Jin Mingri from detention in China earlier this year demonstrates that when the president of the United States intervenes directly, it can make a real, lifesaving difference. title: 黃之鋒再遭判囚10年 預計2036年前後獲釋
summary: 香港民主運動人士黃之鋒5日被香港高等法院以“串謀勾結外國或者境外勢力危害國家安全罪”，判處監禁10年。圖為他出席國際聽證會的情形。 (OLIVIER DOULIERY/AFP) 香港民主運動人士黃之鋒週四（11月5日）被香港高等法院以“串謀勾結外國或者境外勢力危害國家安全罪”，判處監禁10年。法官裁定案件屬於《港區國安法》所稱的“罪行重大”，以13年為量刑起點，再因黃之鋒認罪減至10年。 黃之鋒目前正在就民主派“47人初選案”服刑。新判刑期中，只有兩個月零兩日與原有刑期同時執
content: 香港民主運動人士黃之鋒5日被香港高等法院以“串謀勾結外國或者境外勢力危害國家安全罪”，判處監禁10年。圖為他出席國際聽證會的情形。 (OLIVIER DOULIERY/AFP) 香港民主運動人士黃之鋒週四（11月5日）被香港高等法院以“串謀勾結外國或者境外勢力危害國家安全罪”，判處監禁10年。法官裁定案件屬於《港區國安法》所稱的“罪行重大”，以13年為量刑起點，再因黃之鋒認罪減至10年。 黃之鋒目前正在就民主派“47人初選案”服刑。新判刑期中，只有兩個月零兩日與原有刑期同時執行，其餘刑期將接續執行。他原定於2027年1月服畢初選案刑期，按照目前判決推算，可能要到2036年前後才獲釋，確切日期仍須視香港懲教署計算及減刑安排而定。 前述計算意味著1996年出生，現年30歲的黃之鋒，即使不再遭港府追訴其它案件，也要到40歲左右才能重獲自由。 – (RFA根據媒體報道整理) 法官稱黃之鋒為海外行動提供境內支持 控罪指黃之鋒於2020年7月1日至11月23日期間，與流亡海外的前香港眾志主席羅冠聰及其他人串謀，請求外國政府或機構對中國及香港實施制裁、封鎖或其他被當局認定為敵對的行動。 法官譚耀豪認為，《港區國安法》生效後，羅冠聰繼續在海外推動制裁，黃之鋒則透過外國媒體及社交平臺分享相關內容、引起外國政府關注，並從香港為海外倡議提供支持。法官拒絕辯方所稱黃之鋒角色有限的說法，認為黃與羅冠聰分工合作，兩人的角色同樣重要。 辯方此前主張，本案嚴重程度遠低於其他國安案件；黃之鋒犯案時只有23歲，至今已連續失去自由接近6年，控方相隔多年才提出檢控。辯方建議判刑約4年半，並希望法院留下讓黃之鋒日後照顧父母的機會，但未獲法庭接納。 黃之鋒自2020年11月起持續遭羈押或服刑。這是他第二次因《港區國安法》被定罪，他也是“47人初選案”被告中，唯一再因另一宗國安案件遭到起訴的人。 香港警方國安處總警司李桂華在法院外表示，警方歡迎判決，認為刑期反映案件的嚴重性，並呼籲仍在海外的羅冠聰返回香港自首。香港及北京方面一貫表示，相關執法行動以證據和法律為依據，與被告的政治立場無關，並稱《港區國安法》對恢復香港穩定具有必要性。 2026年11月5日，香港民主活動人士黃之鋒將在高等法院出庭受審。他的支持者聚集在法院外。 (TOMMY WANG/AFP) 臺灣及國際社會批評判刑 臺灣陸委會同日發表聲明，強烈譴責香港當局持續以國家安全為名，侵害港人的基本人權及言論自由。陸委會表示，黃之鋒自2020年底被關押至今已超過2,000天，港府如今再次以國安法重判，是對民主人士進行持續的政治追訴。 陸委會呼籲北京及香港當局停止以國家安全名義打壓民主人士，並立即釋放因行使基本權利而遭到拘押的人士。 人權觀察批評，這項嚴厲判刑是以缺乏依據的國安罪名，讓黃之鋒繼續被長期監禁，並要求香港當局立即無條件釋放他。該組織認為，香港當局不斷對具影響力的民主派人士疊加控罪，目的在於延長其羈押時間。 美國眾議院美中戰略競爭特別委員會主席穆勒納爾稱黃之鋒為對抗威權政權的“英雄”，批評判決反映香港司法獨立遭到侵蝕，並要求立即釋放黃之鋒。

title: 程萬軍遭遣返 臺移民署：因自傷、抗拒曾採取“必要措施”
summary: 流亡海外的中國媒體人程萬軍指控，臺灣移民署在遣返他回泰國、押送他登機期間，曾對他捆綁、堵嘴及毆打。 (圖截取自程萬軍視頻) 曾任中國央視《法律講堂》主講人的程萬軍，週二(3日)在臺灣桃園機場尋求人道庇護，隨後被遣返泰國。他11月4日公開指控，臺灣移民署人員押送他登機期間，曾對他捆綁、堵嘴及毆打。 程萬軍搭乘的班機原定從泰國曼谷經臺灣轉機返回北京，他11月2日抵達桃園機場後，向移民署人員表示自己遭受中共政治迫害，希望暫時留在臺灣，等待前往第三國尋求庇護。 不過，臺灣主管機關審查
content: 流亡海外的中國媒體人程萬軍指控，臺灣移民署在遣返他回泰國、押送他登機期間，曾對他捆綁、堵嘴及毆打。 (圖截取自程萬軍視頻) 曾任中國央視《法律講堂》主講人的程萬軍，週二(3日)在臺灣桃園機場尋求人道庇護，隨後被遣返泰國。他11月4日公開指控，臺灣移民署人員押送他登機期間，曾對他捆綁、堵嘴及毆打。 程萬軍搭乘的班機原定從泰國曼谷經臺灣轉機返回北京，他11月2日抵達桃園機場後，向移民署人員表示自己遭受中共政治迫害，希望暫時留在臺灣，等待前往第三國尋求庇護。 不過，臺灣主管機關審查後未同意其申請，並於3日晚間將他送返曼谷。 程萬軍4日向自由亞洲電臺指控移民署人員在執行遣返過程中，將他捆綁押送，並以毛巾堵嘴、口罩蒙面及勒住手腕等方式限制行動。他還指控自己在機上遭到毆打，身體多處受傷，抵達曼谷後前往醫療機構接受急救。 程萬軍稱，有移民署人員曾對他說“你的死活與我們無關”，並批評臺灣陸委會沒有詳細審查其提交的材料，便決定將他遣返。他表示，將向臺灣監察院及法院提出控告。 上述程萬軍有關遭捆綁、毆打及臺灣官員言論的說法，本臺無法獨立核實。 臺灣移民署回應表示，程萬軍未能就其訴求提出具體事證，不符合援助條件及資格，且沒有有效入境許可，因此依《入出國及移民法》第50條，將他送返泰國曼谷。 移民署同時表示，程萬軍在登機過程中極力抗拒，並出現“自傷”行為，因此採取必要措施維護飛航安全，相關作為均屬依法行政。移民署的聲明未逐項回應程萬軍所稱遭到毆打，以及有官員發表不當言論等指控。 程萬軍提供照片，稱自己遭受毆打，以致身體多處受傷，並於抵達曼谷後前往醫療機構接受急救。 (程萬軍提供) 陸委會：無法核實遭迫害情形 臺灣陸委會4日發佈聲明表示，每年都會發生多起中國人士在臺灣機場尋求暫時留置的類似案件，政府必須建立甄別機制，不可能每件申請都予以接受。 陸委會指出，本案的主要關鍵，是政府無法核實程萬軍所稱遭受迫害的情況。除當事人本人的聲明外，目前沒有其他第三方事證可以佐證；程萬軍也能夠自由進出中國，沒有受到人身自由限制。因此，主管機關只能依既有機制將他送回泰國。 陸委會強調，臺灣政府對中國異議人士一向抱持儘量援助的立場，但有關申請仍須遵守臺灣法律及國境管理制度。 程萬軍則表示，他離開中國後曾在泰國發表反對中共的言論，因此擔心遭遣返回中國。目前他的泰國簽證即將到期，正透過獨立中文筆會及加拿大救援團隊，申請前往第三國避難。 臺灣學者：應評估未來風險 臺灣華人民主書院協會理事長曾建元接受本臺採訪時表示，庇護審查不應只判斷當事人過去是否已經遭受政治迫害，也應評估其未來遭迫害的風險。 他說，程萬軍能夠合法離開中國，並不代表返國後沒有風險。程萬軍在抵達泰國後發表的反共言論，可能增加他被遣返後遭到追究的危險。審查重點應是這種風險是否存在及程度高低，而不是等到迫害事實已經發生，才考慮是否提供保護。 曾建元指出，臺灣至今沒有通過《難民法》，政治庇護也缺乏完整的法律及行政程序。政府只能針對個案作出政治判斷及職權裁量，容易受到不同時空、兩岸關係及國際環境影響，也可能產生處理標準前後不一的問題。 他建議，即使《難民法》短期內難以通過，臺灣政府至少應制定行政命令，明確申請條件、審查程序、所需證據及駁回理由，並讓民間團體及申請人瞭解決定依據。 “每個個案都是政治決定，這並不好。”曾建元說，建立公開標準，才能使申請人知道可能面對哪些風險，也能讓政府的處理立場較為一致。 近年已有多名中國維權人士在桃園機場轉機時尋求庇護。2023年，陳思明在沒有入境臺灣的情況下，最終獲准前往加拿大；今年9月，為北京錫安教會辯護的律師王夏紅一家，也獲臺灣暫時人道安置。但其他數起申請者則遭送返前一出發地。

title: 席位之外：谁将影响下届美国国会的对华议程？
summary: 资料照片：美国华盛顿特区的国会大厦倒映在国会大厦倒影池中。(2026年10月27日) 华盛顿 — 民主党夺回美国国会两院控制权后，影响美国对华政策的下一步变化，将不仅体现在两党席位数量上，还涉及谁来领导外交、军事、拨款及经济领域的关键委员会。 这些委员会可以审议法案、推动听证、监督行政部门，并参与决定资金如何使用。不过，选举胜出并不等于委员会主席人选已经确定。下一届国会的人事安排，仍需经过党内遴选及相关议院程序。 涉华议程由多个委员会共同塑造 美国国会没有一个能够包办全部中国
content: 资料照片：美国华盛顿特区的国会大厦倒映在国会大厦倒影池中。(2026年10月27日) 华盛顿 — 民主党夺回美国国会两院控制权后，影响美国对华政策的下一步变化，将不仅体现在两党席位数量上，还涉及谁来领导外交、军事、拨款及经济领域的关键委员会。 这些委员会可以审议法案、推动听证、监督行政部门，并参与决定资金如何使用。不过，选举胜出并不等于委员会主席人选已经确定。下一届国会的人事安排，仍需经过党内遴选及相关议院程序。 涉华议程由多个委员会共同塑造 美国国会没有一个能够包办全部中国政策的委员会。台湾安全、芯片出口、贸易和投资等议题，分别进入不同委员会的管辖范围，有时还涉及多个委员会。美国之音为您整理出以下列表： 委员会 主要作用 涉华观察重点 参院外交关系委员会、众院外交事务委员会 外交立法、军售相关审查及政府监督；参院外委会还审议相关外交提名 台湾、美中外交、对外援助及人权 两院军事委员会 推动国防政策及《国防授权法案》 印太军事部署、台湾安全合作、国防供应链 两院拨款委员会及相关小组委员会 审议拨款及资金使用条件 国防、外交和安全项目的实际资金 参院银行委员会、众院外交事务委员会等 出口管制相关立法与监督 芯片及半导体制造设备等技术限制 参院财政委员会、众院筹款委员会 贸易和关税立法及监督 对华关税、进口规则和贸易安排 两院情报委员会 情报活动监督与授权立法 中国相关情报评估、网络及反情报议题 这些分工意味着，一项涉华主张能否落实，往往取决于不止一名议员或一个委员会。出口管制属于参院银行委员会的管辖范围，贸易和关税则涉及参院财政委员会及众院筹款委员会；外交事务委员会也对相关出口政策拥有权限。 以年度《国防授权法案》(NDAA)为例。军事委员会通过这项年度立法推动国防政策，但授权法通常不直接提供资金，相关项目仍需查看拨款安排。支持某项安全计划，与为它落实资金，是不同环节。 主席人选尚待确定，哪些议员值得关注？ 参院外委会将出现一个明确的人事变化：该委员会现任民主党资深成员珍妮·沙欣(Jeanne Shaheen)此前已宣布不寻求连任，将在本届任期结束时离任。 彭博政府(Bloomberg Government)11月3日报道，民主党参议员克里斯·库恩斯(Chris Coons)被广泛视为可能接替她、出任该委员会民主党领袖的人选。 库恩斯目前还在参院国防拨款小组委员会担任民主党领袖。 其他值得追踪的现任民主党委员会领袖，包括参院银行委员会的伊丽莎白·沃伦(Elizabeth Warren)，以及众院外交事务委员会的格雷戈里·米克斯(Gregory Meeks)。他们在现届国会中的位置，使其政策主张值得关注，但不能据此直接称他们为“下一届主席”。 沃伦9月已与其他民主党参议员一道，要求加强对先进技术的出口管制。 中国问题特设委员会会继续存在吗？ 众院美国与中国共产党战略竞争特设委员会(简称中国问题特设委员会)近年来通过听证、调查和政策报告，在涉华讨论中受到关注。 该委员会现任主席是共和党人约翰·穆勒纳尔(John Moolenaar)，现任民主党资深成员是罗·康纳(Ro Khanna)。但下一届是否继续设立、权限如何安排以及由谁领导，需要等待新一届众议院的正式决定。 按照现行授权，这个特设委员会可以调查并提出政策建议，却没有直接审议和推进法案的立法管辖权。它提出的建议要成为法律，仍需通过具有相关管辖权的委员会及国会立法程序。 这并不意味着它缺乏影响力。公开听证、调查函和报告可以促使企业及政府机构回应，也能推动其他议员提出法案。但调查中的指控、政策建议和已经生效的法律，具有不同性质。 康纳今年1月就任民主党资深成员时提出，应振兴美国制造业、减少关键矿产依赖，同时保持沟通渠道并重视军事威慑。 CECC与USCC：通过调查和建议影响政策 除两院委员会外，两个依法设立的涉华机构也值得关注。国会及行政当局中国委员会(CECC)由参众两院议员及总统任命的行政部门官员组成，主要监督中国的人权与法治状况，并向总统和国会提交年度报告。其听证、个案记录和政策建议，是观察涉华人权议程的重要窗口。 美中经济与安全审查委员会(USCC)则是立法部门的审查机构，由国会两院两党领袖按法定程序任命的12名委员组成，重点研究美中经贸关系对美国国家安全的影响，并向国会提出立法和行政政策建议。它关注科技、供应链、投资及中国军事发展等领域，委员并非必须由现任国会议员担任。 两者均不直接通过法律、分配预算或执行制裁，但其调查和建议可以为议员推动立法和监督提供依据。它们依据法律设立，与需要下一届众院决定是否续设的中国问题特设委员会不同。 共和党仍可影响议程 即使成为少数党，共和党议员仍可提出法案、参加听证、质询证人，并通过修正案和跨党派合作影响政策。 总统也继续拥有行政权和法案否决权。委员会主席能够推动审议或监督，却不能单独决定关税、批准所有军售，或代表行政部门与北京达成协议。 美国前国防情报局代理局长戴维·谢德(David Shedd)在选前接受美国之音采访时认为，尤其在前沿技术领域，两党对中国安全挑战存在共同关切。不过，共同关切并不意味着对具体限制措施、预算规模及外交方式没有分歧。 接下来要看哪些决定？ 新一届国会议员任期于2027年1月3日开始。在此之前，本届国会仍继续履职。 判断下一届国会如何处理中国议题，仍需继续追踪关键委员会主席及资深成员的正式名单、中国问题特设委员会的授权安排，以及各委员会公布的首批听证、法案和拨款重点。 在中期选举中赢得多数的民主党无疑将在明年新一届国会中拥有更多议程设置权，而接下来由谁来领导有关涉及对华政策的委员会、如何使用这些权力，则将进一步影响哪些涉华主张能够成为实际政策。

title: 习近平“反腐”不停步，原中共中央政治局委员马兴瑞因涉嫌受贿遭起诉
summary: 资料照片：时任新疆维吾尔自治区党委书记的中共中央政治局委员马兴瑞在北京人民大会堂举行的记者会上发言。(2025年3月7日) 中国最高权力机关之一的中共中央政治局前委员马兴瑞最近已经在湖北省宜昌市中级人民法院遭到宜昌市检察院提起公诉。这是中国国家主席习近平长期开展的所谓“反腐”运动的最新进展。 马兴瑞被起诉 中国官媒新华社星期四(11月5日)报道，马兴瑞涉嫌受贿案，由国家监委调查终结，移送检察机关审查起诉，而最高人民检察院以涉嫌受贿罪对其作出逮捕决定，并指定宜昌市人民检察院审查
content: 资料照片：时任新疆维吾尔自治区党委书记的中共中央政治局委员马兴瑞在北京人民大会堂举行的记者会上发言。(2025年3月7日) 中国最高权力机关之一的中共中央政治局前委员马兴瑞最近已经在湖北省宜昌市中级人民法院遭到宜昌市检察院提起公诉。这是中国国家主席习近平长期开展的所谓“反腐”运动的最新进展。 马兴瑞被起诉 中国官媒新华社星期四(11月5日)报道，马兴瑞涉嫌受贿案，由国家监委调查终结，移送检察机关审查起诉，而最高人民检察院以涉嫌受贿罪对其作出逮捕决定，并指定宜昌市人民检察院审查起诉。 宜昌市人民检察院的起诉书指控马兴瑞利用职权或地位形成的便利条件，“为他人谋取利益，非法收受他人财物，数额特别巨大”，依法应当以受贿罪追究其刑事责任。 新华社星期四的报道并未透露马兴瑞作案的手段和细节。 现年67岁的马兴瑞曾任中国航天科技集团总经理、工业和信息化部副部长、中共广东省委副书记、深圳市委书记、广东省人民政府省长。2021年，马兴瑞升任中共新疆维吾尔自治区党委书记。2022年10月，他在中共二十大上当选中共中央政治局委员，晋升为中国所谓“副国级领导人”。 马兴瑞是自2017年7月原重庆市委书记孙正才被清洗以来首位被清洗的文职政治局委员，也是自1990年以来第七位面临正式纪律调查的在任政治局委员。 马兴瑞2025年7月卸任新疆党委书记，并于随后兼任中央农村工作领导小组副组长。 今年4月，新华社官宣马兴瑞“因涉嫌严重违纪违法”，正接受中央纪委国家建委纪律审查和监察调查。新华社在今年7月又官宣马兴瑞被“双开”，即开除党籍、开除公职，他的中国二十大代表资格也被终止，当局还要收缴其违纪违法所得，将其移送司法机关作进一步处理。 根据4月和7月的官方通报，马兴瑞的主要违纪违法问题包括“严重违反政治纪律和政治规矩”，稿权色、钱色交易、拉帮结派；“违规选人用人”，在干部选拔任用工作中为他人谋取利益；“违规经商与家族腐败”，纵容、默许亲属利用其职务影响谋取巨额利益，本人及亲友违规为他人安排工作，帮助亲属低价谋利；“违规收受礼品礼金”，违规收受巨额礼品、礼金；“受贿犯罪”，利用职务便利为他人在企业经营、项目承揽等方面牟利并收受巨额财物。 马兴瑞被“双开”的消息出台后，美国亚洲协会政策研究院中国分析中心研究员牛犇(Neil Thomas)在X平台写道：“习近平能够驱逐一位在任政治局委员，凸显了他在明年中共二十一大召开前依然拥有的强大影响力。” 他还提到，尽管马兴瑞被指控的不当行为主要涉及一位高级官员惊人的“家族腐败”，并未提及政治阴谋或派系斗争。 牛犇在帖子中还提到另一个细节。马兴瑞在担任广东省领导人期间，多家广东企业投资了黑龙江省双鸭山市–他的出生地，也是他哥哥曾任当地官员的小城。 他继续写道：“马兴瑞的清洗也警示世人，中国官员不仅要为自身的腐败负责，还要为亲属和亲信的不当行为负责。” 马兴瑞五中全会被确认开除党籍 上星期，习近平在北京主持召开中共二十届五中全会，进一步强化反腐运动，并在会议上通过了一项关于加强纪律和打击腐败的决议。马兴瑞、前中央军委副主席张又侠、前中共中央对外联络部部长刘建超和前工业和信息化部部长金壮龙等33人被确认开除党籍，创改革开放以来历届中央全会处分人数最多纪录。 当时分析人士告诉美国之音，这波人事汰换反映习近平持续重塑党政军权力结构，旨在确保明年的中共二十一大能无悬念连任。 中共五中全会落幕 开除党籍人数创改革开放以来新高 美联社在报道中指出，习近平的反腐运动既是清除腐败的手段，也是确保各方对其保持忠诚的一种方式。 中共二十大上进入中央政治局的22名委员中目前已有三人被“双开”。这三人除了马兴瑞外，还有两位中央军事委员会副主席何卫东和张又侠。 新华社在报道中提及，检察机关在审查起诉阶段，告知了被告人马兴瑞享有的诉讼权利，询问了被告人，并听取了辩护人的意见。 习近平从十多年前主政起，就一直挥舞大棒，以“反腐”名义大肆党同伐异。外界一直有评论说，反腐是习近平巩固权力和权威基础的重要手段，也是铲除异己，收买民心的有效办法。

content: 来源：德正   Reuters, AFP, 法庭线等 黄之锋上月在狱中度过30岁生日。自2020年11月起，他已因不同案件在狱中还押超过2100天。 （德国之声中文网）香港民主运动代表人物、前香港众志秘书长黄之锋，週四（11月5日）被香港高等法院宣判，因违反香港《国家安全法》下的“串谋勾结外国势力”罪，判处10年监禁；目前因“47人案”正在服刑的黄之锋须服刑至2036年11月，出狱时或已40岁。 黄之锋上月在狱中度过30岁生日。自2020年11月起，他已因不同案件在狱中还押超过2100天。他去年6月被指控，与流亡海外的香港社运人士罗冠聪等人“串谋勾结外国势力危害国家安全”，在狱中被捕，并于今年9月承认该项控罪。但他表示，自己从未主张香港独立，也未曾寻求推翻中国政权。 “我也从未接受外国资金，或花钱聘请外国政治顾问。”黄之锋说。 港媒《法庭线》报道，黄之锋今日上午身穿蓝色深裇衫、咖啡色裤子、戴黑框眼镜，拿著书和一叠绿色簿子，走入法庭。该报记者表示，“法官宣判期间，黄之锋一度望向法庭的时钟，神情看似紧张，似是咬紧了牙。”《集志社》报道，黄之锋听闻判刑时表情平静，一直低头抄写。 主审法官谭耀豪指，被告黄之锋“罪行重大”。本案涉及的犯罪行为发生于2020年7月1日至11月23日之间，案发时香港正受社会动荡的严重影响，国家安全承受极高风险，被告与罗冠聪等人串谋，持续接触外国官员或机构，呼吁制裁中国及香港官员；在国安法实施后依然执行该计划，只是调整了两人的角色。法庭另外裁定，黄与罗为此案主谋。 港警国安处“欢迎重判” 人权组织吁“立即释放” 警方国安处总警司李桂华在宣判后向媒体表示，欢迎法庭重判，并指黄之锋从未成年时已开始参与社运，成年后“犯案累累”，不愿守法、不将法庭放在眼内。李桂华称，黄之锋案件有严重影响，尤其当时正值香港动荡时期，希望他“好好反省”。 人权组织“人权观察”发布声明，呼吁港府应立即无条件释放黄之锋、外国政府应谴责不当拘禁民运人士的判刑，并对负责官员实施制裁。 该组织亚洲部主任艾莲・皮尔逊（Elaine Pearson）表示：“以毫无根据的罪名对黄之锋判处如此严厉的刑罚，既残酷又不公正。” 今年2月，香港传媒大亨黎智英因勾结外国势力及煽动罪，被判处20年监禁。皮尔逊表示：“北京对香港日益加剧的打压，至今并未付出任何实质代价。” 台湾方面，陆委会声明批评中共及港府持续利用“港版国安法”等威权工具，对香港民主人士罗织罪名，进行无止尽的政治追诉。陆委会呼吁，即刻释放无辜遭拘押人士，保障港人应有的基本人权与言论自由。

title: 程万军遭遣返 台移民署：因自伤、抗拒曾采取“必要措施”
summary: 文章来源：rfa 记者：Alan Lu 流亡海外的中国媒体人程万军指控，台湾移民署在遣返他回泰国、押送他登机期间，曾对他捆绑、堵嘴及殴打。 (图截取自程万军视频) 曾任中国央视《法律讲堂》主讲人的程万军，周二(3日)在台湾桃园机场寻求人道庇护，随后被遣返泰国。他11月4日公开指控，台湾移民署人员押送他登机期间，曾对他捆绑、堵嘴及殴打。 程万军搭乘的班机原定从泰国曼谷经台湾转机返回北京，他11月2日抵达桃园机场后，向移民署人员表示自己遭受中共政治迫害，希望暂时留在台湾，等待前往
content: 文章来源：rfa 记者：Alan Lu 流亡海外的中国媒体人程万军指控，台湾移民署在遣返他回泰国、押送他登机期间，曾对他捆绑、堵嘴及殴打。 (图截取自程万军视频) 曾任中国央视《法律讲堂》主讲人的程万军，周二(3日)在台湾桃园机场寻求人道庇护，随后被遣返泰国。他11月4日公开指控，台湾移民署人员押送他登机期间，曾对他捆绑、堵嘴及殴打。 程万军搭乘的班机原定从泰国曼谷经台湾转机返回北京，他11月2日抵达桃园机场后，向移民署人员表示自己遭受中共政治迫害，希望暂时留在台湾，等待前往第三国寻求庇护。 不过，台湾主管机关审查后未同意其申请，并于3日晚间将他送返曼谷。 程万军4日向自由亚洲电台指控移民署人员在执行遣返过程中，将他捆绑押送，并以毛巾堵嘴、口罩蒙面及勒住手腕等方式限制行动。他还指控自己在机上遭到殴打，身体多处受伤，抵达曼谷后前往医疗机构接受急救。 程万军称，有移民署人员曾对他说“你的死活与我们无关”，并批评台湾陆委会没有详细审查其提交的材料，便决定将他遣返。他表示，将向台湾监察院及法院提出控告。 上述程万军有关遭捆绑、殴打及台湾官员言论的说法，本台无法独立核实。 台湾移民署回应表示，程万军未能就其诉求提出具体事证，不符合援助条件及资格，且没有有效入境许可，因此依《入出国及移民法》第50条，将他送返泰国曼谷。 移民署同时表示，程万军在登机过程中极力抗拒，并出现“自伤”行为，因此采取必要措施维护飞航安全，相关作为均属依法行政。移民署的声明未逐项回应程万军所称遭到殴打，以及有官员发表不当言论等指控。 程万军提供照片，称自己遭受殴打，以致身体多处受伤，并于抵达曼谷后前往医疗机构接受急救。  (程万军提供) 陆委会：无法核实遭迫害情形 台湾陆委会4日发布声明表示，每年都会发生多起中国人士在台湾机场寻求暂时留置的类似案件，政府必须建立甄别机制，不可能每件申请都予以接受。 陆委会指出，本案的主要关键，是政府无法核实程万军所称遭受迫害的情况。除当事人本人的声明外，目前没有其他第三方事证可以佐证；程万军也能够自由进出中国，没有受到人身自由限制。因此，主管机关只能依既有机制将他送回泰国。 陆委会强调，台湾政府对中国异议人士一向抱持尽量援助的立场，但有关申请仍须遵守台湾法律及国境管理制度。 程万军则表示，他离开中国后曾在泰国发表反对中共的言论，因此担心遭遣返回中国。目前他的泰国签证即将到期，正透过独立中文笔会及加拿大救援团队，申请前往第三国避难。 台湾学者：应评估未来风险 台湾华人民主书院协会理事长曾建元接受本台采访时表示，庇护审查不应只判断当事人过去是否已经遭受政治迫害，也应评估其未来遭迫害的风险。 他说，程万军能够合法离开中国，并不代表返国后没有风险。程万军在抵达泰国后发表的反共言论，可能增加他被遣返后遭到追究的危险。审查重点应是这种风险是否存在及程度高低，而不是等到迫害事实已经发生，才考虑是否提供保护。 曾建元指出，台湾至今没有通过《难民法》，政治庇护也缺乏完整的法律及行政程序。政府只能针对个案作出政治判断及职权裁量，容易受到不同时空、两岸关系及国际环境影响，也可能产生处理标准前后不一的问题。 他建议，即使《难民法》短期内难以通过，台湾政府至少应制定行政命令，明确申请条件、审查程序、所需证据及驳回理由，并让民间团体及申请人了解决定依据。 “每个个案都是政治决定，这并不好。”曾建元说，建立公开标准，才能使申请人知道可能面对哪些风险，也能让政府的处理立场较为一致。 近年已有多名中国维权人士在桃园机场转机时寻求庇护。2023年，陈思明在没有入境台湾的情况下，最终获准前往加拿大；今年9月，为北京锡安教会辩护的律师王夏红一家，也获台湾暂时人道安置。但其他数起申请者则遭送返前一出发地。 曾建元认为，台湾社会对于接纳难民仍缺乏高度共识，朝野政党也多半回避相关立法，因此《难民法》何时能够通过仍不乐观。程万军案再次凸显，在缺乏明确法律及审查标准的情况下，台湾如何处理中国异议人士的庇护申请，仍高度依赖政府对个案作出的行政裁量。
