content:
KALLEY HUANG, TRIPP MICKLE2026年11月10日
黄仁勋是英伟达的最大个人股东，他的子女也是公司的高管。 Eric Lee for The New York Times
过去四年里，黄仁勋已成为人工智能热潮中的指挥家，也是这场热潮中最不可或缺的亿万富翁高管。
他于1993年共同创立的英伟达估计控制着推动美国经济增长的大型人工智能项目所用计算机芯片市场的90%。这种主导地位使黄仁勋成为世界上最富有的人之一，也成为特朗普总统的盟友。
除了特斯拉的埃隆·马斯克和苹果的史蒂夫·乔布斯，很少有硅谷高管像黄仁勋那样，与自己的公司如此密不可分。他作为首席执行官，管理着英伟达业务的方方面面，他的家庭成员也在公司内部稳步晋升。
这种广泛的控制凸显了英伟达董事会如今面临的挑战。周日，在黄仁勋承认与一名女商人存在恋爱关系后，董事会对其行为展开了调查，美国情报机构已认定该女子是中国的间谍。
“尽管董事会没有理由认为国家安全或英伟达机密受到损害，但董事会的调查将审查所有可获得的信息，”英伟达董事会在声明中说。“黄仁勋完全支持这项审查，并承诺予以合作。”
公司的独立董事将选择外部律师进行调查，公司发言人说黄仁勋不会参与选择过程。
63岁的黄仁勋将在调查期间继续领导英伟达。周日，他在给英伟达员工的信中道歉。“我对妻子不忠，”他写道。“我的行为伤害了她和我们的孩子。我的所作所为没有任何借口。我深感抱歉。”
黄仁勋是英伟达最大的个人股东，持股3.56%，他带领英伟达登上华尔街之巅，并在华盛顿闯出一片天地。他凭借扁平的组织结构和由60多名直接下属组成的高管团队做到这一点，这使他处于公司日常运营的中心。
英伟达以黄仁勋为核心，有60名员工直接向他汇报工作。 Benjamin Fanjoy/Getty Images
如果董事会决定惩罚黄仁勋，这家芯片巨头目前没有明显的继任者，甚至没有备受瞩目的内部候选人。苹果的情况并非如此，蒂姆·库克在乔布斯因胰腺癌去世前不久，无缝接替了他的角色。
早年，英伟达生产名为图形处理器的芯片，主要用于电子游戏。然后，十多年前，黄仁勋押注英伟达的芯片也可用于人工智能开发，并在软件和芯片研发方面投入了数十亿美元。
这一赌注得到了回报。英伟达是第一家市值达到5万亿美元的上市公司。根据标普全球Visible Alpha的数据，今年和2027年，亚马逊、谷歌、Meta和微软预计将在人工智能数据中心等资本支出上合计投入1.842万亿美元。。而这些数据中心中装的正是英伟达的芯片。
“他所谈论的每一件事都推动着整个行业的发展，”技术研究公司TECHnalysis Research首席分析师鲍勃·奥唐奈谈到黄仁勋时说。“他在技术方面有点石成金的能力。”
对英伟达芯片的需求如此旺盛，以至于软件公司甲骨文的联合创始人拉里·埃里森在2024年回忆起在加州帕洛阿尔托的一顿寿司晚餐，当时他和特斯拉及SpaceX首席执行官埃隆·马斯克恳求黄仁勋提供更多芯片。
“请拿走我们的钱，”埃里森回忆起他对黄仁勋说的话。“多拿一些。你拿得不够多。我们需要你多拿我们的钱，拜托。”
英伟达的飞速崛起使黄仁勋成为名人。他标志性的黑色皮夹克之一在拍卖会上以近100万美元售出。英伟达的开发者大会成为硅谷最抢手的活动，参会者排队数小时只为看黄仁勋演讲。
黄仁勋开始在活动中被索要签名的人群包围，甚至有一位女士要求他在她的胸前签名。在这一切喧嚣中，他继续以硅谷资深人士所称的那种类似苹果乔布斯的“现实扭曲力场”领导英伟达。
“当我在脑海中相信它时——你知道那种感觉——你就会显化出一个未来，而这个未来如此令人信服，以至于它不可能不发生，”黄仁勋在3月的一档播客中说。
黄仁勋的崛起帮助他赢得特朗普的青睐。在缺席了许多科技高管都出席的总统就职典礼后，黄仁勋飞往马阿拉歌庄园，参加了一场捐款人晚宴，并以自己作为台湾移民，共同创立了后来成为全球最有价值公司的个人经历打动了特朗普。（英伟达股价近几周有所下跌，截至上周交易，苹果市值更高。）
两人经常通电话。特朗普曾在黄仁勋最近出席一场科技会议时致电打断他，也曾在英伟达一次全员会议上致电打断他。
黄仁勋在塑造特朗普的人工智能政策方面发挥了巨大作用。去年，他说服政府撤销对中国的芯片销售限制。据两名了解其参与情况的人士说，今年，他帮助阻止了一项建立监管程序以评估人工智能系统并确保其安全的计划。取而代之的是，他帮助推动主要人工智能公司领导人做出承诺，确保其产品遵守自愿性保障措施。
“如果我相信我即将推出一款不安全的产品，那么不推出它，完全在我的能力、权力和责任范围之内，而且我也有动力这样做，”黄仁勋在9月的“埃兹拉·克莱因秀”播客中解释他反对人工智能监管时说。
黄仁勋以非正统的管理风格闻名。在2023年的一档播客中，他对传统的组织架构图表示不屑，说“那些东西对我毫无意义”。他主要通过在聚焦特定项目的会议来领导英伟达，参会者包括公司各层级人员，从刚毕业的大学生到高层高管。他说自己每天要阅读来自公司各处人员的数千封电子邮件。
黄仁勋还在英伟达董事会中安插了早期投资者和商业伙伴。10名董事会成员中有两人与1993年最初投资英伟达的风险投资公司有关联，另外两人是上世纪90年代与英伟达合作的一家芯片设计公司的高管。
其他董事会成员包括塔可钟前总裁、美国国家橄榄球联盟前首席营销官和一名工程学教授。据三名前员工说，黄仁勋主要将英伟达董事会视为治理要求，而非公司战略或执行的重要组成部分。
据五名现任和前任员工说，过去几年，黄仁勋赋予子女在英伟达更多权力和权威。他的儿子黄胜斌是产品管理总监，在英伟达的机器人业务中发挥主导作用。他的女儿黄敏珊是产品营销高级总监，也从事机器人以及传播和营销工作。他的女婿尼科·卡普雷斯负责公司业务发展。
黄仁勋家族在公司事务中日益扩大的影响力让公司内部一些人感到不满，并给人留下这样一种印象：黄仁勋正在培养自己的子女，以便他们最终接替自己的职位。这在会议上造成了不寻常的权力态势，因为子女可以直接接触黄仁勋，而他对英伟达所有重大决策拥有最终决定权。公司一些客户、供应商和顾问也已开始与他的子女建立关系。
目前尚不清楚董事会的调查需要多长时间。但即使董事会驱逐黄仁勋，他也曾表示，董事会应有众多接班人选可供选择。

title: 美国商务部就芯片展开的调查在英伟达介入后中止
source: 纽约时报中文网 国际纵览
summary: ANA SWANSON, DEVLIN BARRETT2026年11月10日 英伟达周日表示，已对黄仁勋展开调查。此前，他承认曾与一家涉嫌向中国走私芯片的新加坡公司的高管有过亲密关系。 Manuel Orbegozo for The New York Times 美国商务部的调查人员花费数月时间，深入调查一家涉嫌将英伟达人工智能芯片走私到中国的新加坡公司，但在去年年底，相关工作突然中止。 调查的焦点是数据中心公司Megaspeed。该公司由一名曾与英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋有过亲
content:
ANA SWANSON, DEVLIN BARRETT2026年11月10日
英伟达周日表示，已对黄仁勋展开调查。此前，他承认曾与一家涉嫌向中国走私芯片的新加坡公司的高管有过亲密关系。 Manuel Orbegozo for The New York Times
美国商务部的调查人员花费数月时间，深入调查一家涉嫌将英伟达人工智能芯片走私到中国的新加坡公司，但在去年年底，相关工作突然中止。
调查的焦点是数据中心公司Megaspeed。该公司由一名曾与英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋有过亲密关系的高管领导，美国官员如今认为，这名高管是中国间谍。
但去年，这起案件突然被移交司法部。此前，负责此案的商务部调查人员收到英伟达总法律顾问的一封电子邮件，询问有关Megaspeed调查的信息。
商务部调查人员在办案过程中与涉案企业的代表沟通相关问题本不是什么稀奇事。但这封邮件的内容却非同寻常。英伟达总法律顾问蒂姆·泰特说，商务部高级官员杰夫·凯斯勒已允许英伟达就此事联系。
调查人员感到警觉的是，英伟达提到了他们的上级凯斯勒的名字，而凯斯勒是由特朗普总统提名担任该职位的。据现任和前任政府官员及其他了解此事的人士说，一些人认为凯斯勒与英伟达的接触违反了政府程序，并可能影响案件调查的公正性。
目前尚不清楚是什么促使泰特联系商务部。但最近曝光的黄仁勋承认与Megaspeed一名高管有染的消息使英伟达在影响美国对华芯片销售政策方面所扮演的角色受到更严格的审视。《纽约时报》上个月报道，美国政府已认定，该公司高管黄乐（音，其英文名为Alice Huang）是为中国政府工作的间谍。
周日，英伟达表示，在黄仁勋向公司董事会承认与黄乐有过亲密关系后，已对他展开调查。两人曾多次被拍到在一起，包括与其他科技企业高管共同出现在台湾的酒吧和餐厅。
这起事件引发了外界的质疑：直接向商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克汇报的凯斯勒究竟与英伟达讨论了什么？双方的谈话本身也可能受到进一步调查。
一些官员表示，凯斯勒或许并非有意如此，但他的做法使自己面临受到不当影响的指责，也可能危及商务部对Megaspeed的调查。
这些人说，案件很快被移交司法部，以避免政府对Megaspeed的调查受到任何潜在损害。据知情人士透露，司法部正在对Megaspeed进行刑事调查。
司法部发言人说，该机构不对正在进行的调查置评。商务部发言人说，该部一直大力执行有关规定，此案及其他执法行动都严格依照程序进行。
英伟达发言人约翰·里佐说，公司会与官员磋商，“回答他们的问题，提供我们从一线收集的信息，征求他们的指导和指示，并询问他们是否有需要进一步了解的问题。”
他补充说，公司致力于“协助政府和合作伙伴阻止潜在的走私活动，同时服务于合法客户这一重要市场，助力美国在全球竞争中取胜”。
2024年6月，黄仁勋与Megaspeed高管黄乐在台北的一场聚会上。NetThunder公司在领英上发布了这张照片。
Megaspeed的一名代表表示，公司正在对芯片转移流向的相关指控展开内部调查，并曾多次主动提出配合美国政府调查，但均未得到回应。
美国于2024年开始调查Megaspeed和黄乐，此前该公司开始向马来西亚进口价值数十亿美元的英伟达先进人工智能设备。Megaspeed一直在东南亚各地规划和建设数据中心，以服务中国客户，包括中国科技巨头阿里巴巴。尽管这种商业活动本身合法，但美国官员担心该公司购买的一些英伟达芯片被非法转运至中国。
美国通过出口管制限制向中国销售某些技术，禁止部分芯片出口到中国，并要求美国企业在销售其他一些芯片前取得许可证。英伟达一直反对这些管制措施，主张允许公司更自由地销售产品。
据知情人士透露，2025年8月，商务部工业与安全局负责调查此案的官员收到英伟达总法律顾问泰特的一封电子邮件。泰特在发给调查人员的信息中表示，凯斯勒已允许他就此案与调查人员联系。
一名商务部官员说，英伟达直接联系了这些员工，请求与其中一人会面。工作人员拒绝后，泰特回复这些员工，他不确定问题出在哪里，因为凯斯勒说过英伟达可以与工业与安全局员工沟通。
这名官员说，工作人员将往来邮件转发给凯斯勒。数小时后，凯斯勒回复说，他们应该继续严格按照规定程序办理此案。
这名官员表示，凯斯勒没有命令下属向英伟达披露信息，也没有干预调查人员决定接受哪些会面请求或披露哪些信息。
作为副部长，凯斯勒通常会与这类调查的更细节内容隔离，因为他可能被要求在该案中充当中立仲裁者。官员们说，如果商务部未来对Megaspeed采取法律行动，凯斯勒与英伟达的接触也可能被纳入诉讼证据开示程序，或成为传票要求披露的内容。
目前尚不清楚是否还有其他因素促使商务部决定暂停调查。作出这一决定的时间，也恰逢美国情报机构收集到后来用于认定黄乐为中国政府从事间谍活动的情报。2025年10月，特朗普曾听取简报，得知黄乐与黄仁勋存在亲密关系，并被怀疑是一名间谍，但总统决定不依据此情报采取任何行动。
司法部和商务部经常联合调查出口管制案件，但在涉及刑事犯罪和情报问题的案件中，司法部可以主导调查。司法部可以追究刑事责任，通常需要达到更高的举证标准；商务部则可以实施包括罚款在内的民事处罚。
但官员们表示，此案从商务部移交出去的方式不同寻常，令人担忧。
几名要求匿名讨论这一高度敏感问题的官员质疑，商务部为什么与仍有可能成为调查对象的英伟达讨论此案。
在泰特发来邮件后，商务部官员召开会议讨论此事，并迅速向合作执法机构做了通报。一名知情人士表示，司法部要求商务部暂停调查工作，商务部照办了。
这一结果令调查Megaspeed的执法人员感到沮丧，他们已经花费数月时间搜集证据、构建案件。这也可能使商务部错失了更早采取行动、阻止向Megaspeed运送相关产品的机会。
商务部内外的一些政府官员此前就对特朗普政府过于迁就英伟达感到担忧。英伟达是推动美国人工智能产业增长和股市上涨的重要力量。黄仁勋在出口管制政策上对特朗普和商务部长卢特尼克都具有重要影响力，而商务部负责管理美国技术出口。
特朗普政府（包括司法部在内）也一直认为，联邦政府应避免作出妨碍美国企业主导人工智能行业的监管或执法决定。英伟达的芯片是推动该行业发展的重要力量。
自特朗普重返白宫以来，凯斯勒及商务部其他领导人规定，任何涉及英伟达的调查，以及与该公司的其他接触，都必须事先获得他们批准。直接向卢特尼克汇报的凯斯勒还对该部发放的许可证保持严格控制，其中许多涉及英伟达技术，并对商务部与该公司的沟通实行严格管理。
虽然其他机构曾提议将Megaspeed列入实体清单，也就是由商务部管理的贸易黑名单，但商务部一直没有采取行动。该部已一年多没有将任何公司列入实体清单，这是18年来未新增实体的最长间隔。

title: 北京否认与黄仁勋有亲密关系的女性为中国间谍
source: 纽约时报中文网 国际纵览
summary: 英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋10月在华盛顿。黄仁勋承认与一名商界高管有亲密关系，美国官员怀疑该高管向中国情报部门提供情报。 Demetrius Freeman for The New York Times 周一，中国外交部发言人否认了与英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋有亲密关系的女性是中国间谍的说法。发言人将这些报道斥为“纯属捕风捉影”和“污蔑抹黑”。 中国外交部的回应凸显出，这起涉及全球最知名科技高管之一的事件已卷入华盛顿与北京之间日益激烈的竞争之中。 周日，黄仁勋承认与一名中国商界高管黄
content:
英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋10月在华盛顿。黄仁勋承认与一名商界高管有亲密关系，美国官员怀疑该高管向中国情报部门提供情报。 Demetrius Freeman for The New York Times
周一，中国外交部发言人否认了与英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋有亲密关系的女性是中国间谍的说法。发言人将这些报道斥为“纯属捕风捉影”和“污蔑抹黑”。
中国外交部的回应凸显出，这起涉及全球最知名科技高管之一的事件已卷入华盛顿与北京之间日益激烈的竞争之中。
周日，黄仁勋承认与一名中国商界高管黄乐（音，其英文名为Alice Huang）存在亲密关系，美国官员怀疑她向中国情报机构提供信息。英伟达表示，正在对黄仁勋的行为展开调查。公司董事会表示，没有理由认为国家安全或英伟达机密已受到损害。
尽管美国官员提出了国家安全方面的担忧，一些议员还呼吁黄仁勋到国会作证，但中国的反应是淡化此事的重要性。
中国官员试图否定间谍指控，而社交媒体用户则抓住这位美国亿万富翁的个人风波不放，他的公司正处于美中争夺人工智能行业主导权的核心。
在受到严格审查的中国社交媒体平台微博上，用户似乎乐于看到一位长期在亚洲广受钦佩的科技界名人的形象崩塌。
“黄仁勋41年爱妻人设崩塌”是周一上午该平台最热门的议题。也有用户指责美国新闻媒体抹黑黄乐，她与英伟达联合创始人黄仁勋没有亲属关系。
这场争议始于《纽约时报》报道称，美国政府官员认定，新加坡科技公司Megaspeed高管黄乐正在为北京收集情报。
美国政府一直在调查Megaspeed是否是否违反美国出口管制规定，协助将英伟达的先进人工智能芯片转运至中国。《纽约时报》报道，当局一年多前开始监视黄乐，并发现她与一名美国公民有联系，该公民后来被确认为黄仁勋。
“我对妻子不忠，”63岁的黄仁勋周日说。此前英伟达曾表示，他们的关系是正常业务往来的一部分。“我的行为伤害了她和我们的孩子。我的所作所为没有任何借口。我深感抱歉。”
这项调查可能使黄仁勋与特朗普总统的关系变得复杂。黄仁勋已成为总统在科技行业的一位有影响力的盟友，尽管他一直敦促政府放宽限制英伟达向中国公司出售先进芯片的出口限制。5月，黄仁勋随特朗普的访华代表团一同前往中国。
黄仁勋辩称，美国的国家安全担忧被夸大了，因为中国军方不需要英伟达的芯片来开发人工智能技术，而美国若将自己与中国庞大市场隔绝，将面临丧失技术领导地位的风险。
中国官员否认黄乐是间谍。周一，一些著名的民族主义评论员也表达了同样的立场。
中国执政党控制的《环球时报》前总编辑胡锡进将这场风波说成美国的政治阴谋。他称这一爆料是“民主党和美国建制派搞垮黄仁勋，并进而搞特朗普的一种方式”。类似说法也在社交媒体上流传。
对黄仁勋来说，这场争议尤其引人注目，因为他在亚洲各地拥有非凡的人气，其名人地位在企业高管中非常罕见。
黄仁勋出生于台湾，在美国长大，他塑造了一种富有魅力的领导人形象，能够弥合美中科技行业之间日益扩大的裂痕。
他在台北、首尔和北京的露面常常会吸引通常只有好莱坞电影明星或职业运动员才能招来的拥挤人群。在科技会议上，粉丝追随他索要签名和合影。他标志性的黑色皮夹克在整个地区变得一眼就能认出。
去年访问韩国时，黄仁勋与该国一些最有影响力的半导体高管一起吃炸鸡喝啤酒，吸引了大量围观者和记者。当人群聚集在外面时，他向围观者分发零食。
在北京，他经常光顾社区餐馆和食品摊，大口吸着面条，与当地人打成一片。这类外出活动的视频在社交媒体上广泛传播，强化了他平易近人的亿万富翁形象。
在台湾社交媒体上，一些用户对黄仁勋可能做出如此缺乏判断力的行为表示难以置信和失望。他常被当作归来的英雄，长期被视为忠诚的爱家男人。他的人气极高，以至于一些台湾人称他为“爸爸”，这是当地对受敬仰人物的亲昵称呼。
在台湾，对中国可能入侵的担忧笼罩着公共生活，网络评论人士对间谍活动表示担忧，想知道黄乐是如何进入这个自治岛屿的。
尽管如此，黄仁勋可能很快返回亚洲。周日，特朗普总统表示，他仍计划带上黄仁勋参加即将到来的亚洲之行，出席在中国主办的亚太经合组织论坛。中国最高领导人习近平将主持此次活动，先进半导体技术和人工智能预计将是会议焦点。

title: 黄仁勋对特朗普称自己不知婚外情对象疑似中国间谍
source: 纽约时报中文网 国际纵览

content:
LUKE BROADWATER, MAGGIE HABERMAN2026年11月10日
英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋，摄于今年早些时候。他与一名疑似中国间谍的关系震动了他的公司，这家强大的芯片制造商正驱动着支撑美国经济的数据中心繁荣。 Manuel Orbegozo for The New York Times
特朗普总统周一表示，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋告诉他，自己并不知道与其有亲密关系的一名中国女商人是北京的情报人员。
“我问了他那个问题：‘你对她是个间谍一无所知吗？’”特朗普在白宫告诉记者。“他说，‘我完全不知道她是间谍，’而我真的相信他。”
在特朗普发表此番言论前，《纽约时报》的一系列报道披露，美国官员已得出结论，这位名为黄乐（音，其英文名为Alice Huang）的女子已被中国主要间谍机构招募，并且特朗普及其他高级官员已收到过关于这段关系的警告。
《纽约时报》上月报道称，大约一年前，特朗普曾听取过关于电子监控的简报，监控显示美国情报界认为黄女士是中国政府的情报人员。总统当时选择不对该信息采取任何行动。
据《纽约时报》周五报道，国家安全顾问兼国务卿马尔科·鲁比奥在今年春天监督起草了一份高度机密的备忘录，向特朗普政府高级官员警告了黄乐的情况，以及关于她是中国国家安全部间谍的情报评估。
当被问及5月份邀请黄仁勋登上“空军一号”前往中国时，他是否知道“与中国间谍的所谓联系”，总统表示：“不，我当时没听说过此事。”
当被追问大约一年前他是否收到过关于该问题的简报时，特朗普未作正面回答。
“我得查一下，”他在回答关于首次得知此事的时间时说。“我肯定会向情报人员核实。这些事可能被提及过。当然，它并没有对我产生太大影响。”
黄仁勋在周日公开承认了他与黄女士的关系，此事震动了英伟达，这家强大的芯片制造商驱动着支撑美国经济的数据中心繁荣。
英伟达周日表示，在黄仁勋将他与黄乐的关系告知董事会后，公司正在对他展开调查。（黄仁勋与黄乐没有亲属关系。）
“我对妻子不忠，”黄仁勋在给公司的一份消息中说。“我的行为伤害了她和我们的孩子。我的所作所为没有任何借口。我深表歉意。”
在特朗普的第二任期内，总统与黄仁勋已成为亲密盟友。英伟达已为特朗普珍视的白宫宴会厅项目基金捐赠了至少2000万美元。此外，黄仁勋已说服总统撤销了对华芯片销售禁令。
周一向记者发表讲话时，总统表示他主要关心的是黄仁勋在这场丑闻中状态如何。
“我今天确实和他通了话，只是想看看他感觉怎么样，”特朗普说，并且“我相信他非常痛苦。我读了他的声明，我相信他非常痛苦。更多是因为他的家人，他深爱的妻子和他的家人，但他绝对很痛苦。”
总统表示，联邦调查局一直在调查一件与黄仁勋有关的事情，但他说，他相信这位商人没有做错任何事。
特朗普似乎指的是司法部接手了商务部的一项调查，该调查旨在查明Megaspeed公司是否在非法向中国输送先进芯片。黄乐曾担任该公司的高管，且该公司购买了20亿美元的英伟达产品。
“我知道联邦调查局正在调查其他方面的事情，我认为他会没事的，”特朗普说。
下周，特朗普计划前往中国深圳参加亚太经合组织峰会，他预计将在那里会见中国国家主席习近平。
“我确信习主席会问我这件事，”特朗普说。“我只是非常了解黄仁勋。我只是觉得他是一个非常正直的人。我的意思是，他很了不起。他建立了一家伟大的公司，一家美国公司，我认为他是一个非常正直的人。而且我非常有信心他会没事的。”

title: Why Britain needs a maritime-first defense strategy
zh_title: 为什么英国需要海上优先的防御战略
summary: 唐纳德·特朗普总统对北约的态度和政策引起了极大的惊愕和担忧，并且几乎肯定会在他的总统任期的剩余两年中继续这样做。然而，对特朗普破坏性的关注（这反映了美国政界两党长期以来重新平衡美国和欧洲之间负担的愿望）忽视了其中为成员国和整个联盟隐藏的机会。这不会是一帆风顺或无痛的，但特朗普推动的所谓北约3.0为英国等国家提供了一个重新定位的机会。
content:
唐纳德·特朗普总统对北约的态度和政策引起了极大的惊愕和担忧，并且几乎肯定会在他的总统任期的剩余两年中继续这样做。然而，对特朗普破坏性的关注（这反映了美国政界两党长期以来重新平衡美国和欧洲之间负担的愿望）忽视了其中为成员国和整个联盟隐藏的机会。

这不会是顺利或无痛的，但特朗普推动所谓的北约3.0为英国等国家提供了一个重新考虑其防御方式的机会，特别是在海上。

在我为伦敦繁荣研究所撰写的论文“[Reclaiming the Waves](https://www.prosperity.com/media-publications/reclaiming-the-waves/)”中，我概述了英国的“海事优先”（但不仅仅是）方法。这种方法借鉴了朱利安·科贝特爵士的十九世纪和二十世纪战略，尽管针对现代世界进行了更新，但重点是利用海军力量控制对贸易至关重要的关键海上交通线。

虽然帝国的太阳早已落下，而且目前单一势力统治这片大陆的可能性很小，但基本原则仍然有效。我更新的海上战略遵循类似的逻辑，利用北约欧洲支柱内部正在发生的变化。
英国应奉行海上优先的国防方针，这是基于对三个因素的评估：英国的国家利益、英国现有的能力和资源限制以及欧洲支柱在北约内部的当前轨迹，这代表了北约3.0的机遇。尽管英国在印度-太平洋地区有利益，但它缺乏资源和能力来维持在该地区的存在并优先考虑欧洲-大西洋地区，因此必须优先考虑后者。

与此同时，在北约3.0下，美国希望将常规负担从美国转移到联盟的欧洲成员身上。尽管有中期选举的结果，但这些趋势线只会缓和，不会像特朗普之前那样彻底改变。

过去两年，欧洲各国政府对特朗普担任总统期间在国防开支和北约问题上发出的信号和噪音做出了回应。特朗普在格陵兰岛问题上对丹麦的怒火、对挪威等国的公开敌意、对乌克兰的压力以及寻求改善与俄罗斯的关系，都加速了欧洲对更大国防自主权的渴望——白宫在一定程度上鼓励了这一点，尽管官员们也对欧洲国家希望摆脱美国武器的想法表示失望。
波兰[目标](https://kyivindependent.com/poland-will-soon-have-europes-largest-army-tusk-pledges/)将其武装部队规模扩大一倍。德国在其“欧洲责任”军事理念中，[寻求](https://www.defensenews.com/global/europe/2026/04/22/germany-unveils-strategy-for-becoming-europes-strongest-military-by-2039/)到2039年建立欧洲大陆最强大的军队。随着各国签署协议，欧洲间防务合作正在飞速发展发表政治合作宣言并签署协议，以加强非洲大陆的国防工业基础。最值得注意和重要的是，在 2025 年海牙北约峰会上，成员国（西班牙除外）[同意](https://www.nato.int/en/about-us

【原文 English Original】
President Donald Trump’s attitude and policies towards NATO have caused much consternation and concern, and will almost certainly continue to do so over the remaining two years of his presidency. Yet the attention on Trump’s disruption (which reflects a long-running bipartisan desire in American political circles to rebalance the burden between America and Europe) misses the opportunities hidden therein for member states and the alliance as a whole.

It won’t be smooth or painless, but Trump’s push for the so-called NATO 3.0 contains an opportunity for countries such as the United Kingdom to reconsider their approach to defense, particularly on the seas.

In my paper “[Reclaiming the Waves](https://www.prosperity.com/media-publications/reclaiming-the-waves/),” written for the Prosperity Institute in London, I outline a “maritime-first” (but not only) approach for the UK. This approach borrows from the nineteenth and twentieth century strategy of Sir Julian Corbett, albeit updated for the modern world, focused on using naval power to control the critical sea lines of communication vital for trade.

While the sun is long set on empire and the likelihood of a single power dominating the continent is currently remote, the underlying principles remain valid. My updated maritime strategy follows a similar train of logic, taking advantage of the changes underway within the European pillar of NATO.

That Britain should pursue a maritime-first approach to defense is based on an assessment of three factors: British national interests, present British capabilities and resource limitations and the current trajectory of the European pillar within NATO, which represents the opportunity of NATO 3.0. While the United Kingdom has interests in the Indo-Pacific, it lacks the resources and capabilities to sustain a presence in both the region and prioritize the Euro-Atlantic, necessitating prioritization for the latter over the former.

Concurrently, under NATO 3.0, the United States wants to shift the conventional burden from the US to the European members of the alliance. Despite the results of the midterm elections, these trendlines will only moderate, not definitively change as they pre-dated Trump.

Over the last two years, European governments have responded to both the signal and the noise of the Trump presidency on defense spending and NATO. Trump’s fire and fury at Denmark over Greenland, open hostility to countries like Norway, pressure on Ukraine and pursuit of improved relations with Russia have accelerated the European desire for greater defense autonomy — something the White House has encouraged to an extent, although officials have also expressed frustration with the idea that European nations would want to wean off of American weapons.

Poland [aims](https://kyivindependent.com/poland-will-soon-have-europes-largest-army-tusk-pledges/) to double the size of its armed forces. Germany, in its “Responsibility for Europe” military concept, [seeks](https://www.defensenews.com/global/europe/2026/04/22/germany-unveils-strategy-for-becoming-europes-strongest-military-by-2039/) to build the strongest army on the continent by 2039. Inter-European defense cooperation is skyrocketing with countries signing political declarations of cooperation and inking deals to strengthen the continent’s defense industrial base. Most notably and significantly, at the 2025 Hague NATO Summit, the member states (aside from Spain) [agreed](https://www.nato.int/en/about-us/official-texts-and-resources/official-texts/2025/06/25/the-hague-summit-declaration) to increase core defense spending to 3.5 percent of GDP and military-related expenditures to 1.5 percent of GDP by 2035.

## Rethinking British National Defense

The increased spending and ambitions of European governments to expand the size of their armed forces does, of course, face political and fiscal headwinds. Yet the direction of travel is clear: Europe is doing more and will do more in the future. This creates an opportunity to rethink how individual countries consider their defense strategies.

In the case of the United Kingdom, I argue that the British armed forces should focus more on the maritime and associated domains, developing credible naval, air and space power to pursue its own interests and develop and deliver deterrent effects on the continent. Such an approach would take advantage of the continental changes happening today.

London must first secure the area around its unique strategic geography — it is an island-nation and that will never change. Through these waters flow the United Kingdom’s lifeblood: more than 40 percent of its energy is [imported](https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/6a69ee040825cc51a6c37d04/DUKES_2026_Chapter_1.pdf), over 99 percent of its data [flow](https://www.gov.uk/government/consultations/proposals-for-new-legislation-to-strengthen-the-security-and-resilience-of-critical-undersea-infrastructure-cui/critical-undersea-infrastructure-security-and-resilience-proposals-for-modernising-the-uks-legislation-white-paper) through 60 subsea [cables](https://committees.parliament.uk/work/8879/undersea-cables/news/) and some 95 percent of its imports and exports [move](https://www.maritimeuk.org/about/our-sector/shipping/) via the sea. Russia has already shown a [willingness](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cre13qn9z7do) to target subsea infrastructure, and just this month [sailed](https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2026/11/02/royal-navy-intercepts-russia-spy-ship-off-scotland/) an intelligence collection ship through British waters. There is little to suggest it will not do so again in the future. This requires greater investments in and sustainment of naval and air power in these critical waterways, as well as infrastructure resilience.

To achieve an updated Corbettian concept of “command of the sea” to a broader understanding of “area control” and “area denial,” which includes air, surface and subsurface and space domains, the United Kingdom will need to invest in expanding and modernizing its navy.

This must consist of primarily crewed vessels, augmented by uncrewed systems, integrated via an emergent digital kill web connecting terrestrial and space-based sensors and effectors, such as the Nyan attack drone — recently [tested](https://www.baesystems.com/en/article/uk-made-strike-drones-launch-from-hms-queen-elizabeth) from the HMS Queen Elizabeth. The proposed Common Combat Vessels (CCVs), a replacement for the Type 45, and the construction of the Type 26 anti-submarine warfare frigate with Norway are illustrative of these types of necessary investments and programs. In the submarine domain, the SSN-AUKUS — albeit over a decade away — will replace the Astute-class of SSNs. Such investments will also see the UK better able to protect the vital reinforcement line from the United States, vital for victory in the Second World War and to defense and deterrence in the Cold War, but the safety of which is now in [doubt](https://www.navylookout.com/european-naval-chiefs-meet-to-discuss-north-atlantic-defence-without-the-royal-navy/).

The United Kingdom’s [leadership](https://www.gov.uk/government/news/50bn-boost-for-european-deep-precision-strike-capabilities-as-uk-leads-new-initiative) of the $50 billion European deep precision strike program will markedly enhance both Great Britain’s but also NATO’s ability to hit targets out to 300 kilometers and beyond from both maritime and ground platforms. Such capabilities, in concert with evolving deep strike assets — in which the United Kingdom is already investing — mean that Great Britain can deliver deterrent effects much further into the continent and further from shore. Home protection is necessary, but the idea of a “[Britannia Shield”](https://www.conservatives.com/news/britannia-shield) is less so. Moreover, prioritizing investments in these areas will have a material benefit for the British economy: higher tech, greater innovation and serving as a competitive advantage.

Maritime-first, does not, of course, mean maritime-only. The British Army would, in turn, take advantage of NATO 3.0 and focus its energies and resources on developing a credible, sustainable and fully-resourced heavy division capable of meeting British commitments to NATO. It would then, having developed this division, turn to resourcing a second deployable division.

German and Polish ambitions, even if not fully met, mean a much stronger European land force, to which a small British contingent offers less overall, than a comprehensive maritime portfolio. One division is ultimately insufficient for British interests, but spreading resources over incomplete and incapable orders of battle — as at present — undermines credibility with allies and adversaries alike. Indeed, in conversations with the UK’s Joint Expeditionary Force partners, concerns were raised about London’s ability to meet its obligations and commitments.

Collectively, the maritime-first approach I outline argues for the development of British enabling capabilities such as integrated air and missile defense and intelligence, surveillance, reconnaissance and targeting, to support core national interests but also to serve as a backstop to America’s backstop within NATO. This moment of burden-shifting therefore offers an opportunity for countries, like the United Kingdom, to reconsider their own defense priorities and investments, and craft a new defense pillar around which to build Service-specific strategies.

NATO is changing, but this change represents an opportunity on which London, and others, should seize to strengthen their own core national defense interests and the overall alliance.

_Joshua C. Huminski is the Senior Vice President for National Security & Intelligence at the Center for the Study of the Presidency & Congress, a George Mason University National Security Institute Senior Fellow, and an International Fellow with the London-based Council on Geostrategy. He is currently writing a book on the future of European defense. He can be found on Twitter @joshuachuminski._

The U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) preliminarily determines that polytetramethylene ether glycol (PTMEG) from Taiwan is being, or is likely to be, sold in the United States at less than fair value (LTFV). The period of investigation (POI) is April 1, 2025, through March 31, 2026. Interested parties are invited to comment on this preliminary determination.
Applicable November 10, 2026.
Javeria Ali or Jacob Waddell, AD/CVD Operations, Office VI, Enforcement and Compliance, International Trade Administration, U.S. Department of Commerce, 1401 Constitution Avenue NW, Washington, DC 20230; telephone: (202) 482-0462 or (202) 482-1369, respectively.
This preliminary determination is made in accordance with section 733(b) of the Tariff Act of 1930, as amended (the Act). Commerce published the notice of initiation of this investigation on May 5, 2026.[1] On August 28, 2026, Commerce postponed the preliminary determination of this investigation and the revised deadline is now November 4, 2026.[2]
For a complete description of the events that followed the initiation of this investigation, see the Preliminary Decision Memorandum.[3] A list of topics ( printed page 72518) included in the Preliminary Decision Memorandum is included as Appendix II to this notice. The Preliminary Decision Memorandum is a public document and is on file electronically via Enforcement and Compliance's Antidumping and Countervailing Duty Centralized Electronic Service System (ACCESS), which is available to registered users at https://access.trade.gov. In addition, a complete version of the Preliminary Decision Memorandum can be accessed directly at https://access.trade.gov/​frnotices.
The product covered by this investigation is PTMEG from Taiwan. For a complete description of the scope of this investigation, see Appendix I.
In accordance with the Preamble to Commerce's regulations,[4] the Initiation Notice set aside a period of time for parties to raise issues regarding product coverage ( i.e., scope).[5] Certain interested parties commented on the scope of the investigation as it appeared in the Initiation Notice. For a summary of the product coverage comments and rebuttal comments submitted to the record for this preliminary determination, and accompanying discussion and analysis of all comments timely received, see the Preliminary Scope Decision Memorandum.[6] Commerce is preliminarily not modifying the scope language as it appeared in the Initiation Notice. See the scope in Appendix I to this notice.
Commerce is conducting this investigation in accordance with section 731 of the Act. Commerce has calculated export prices in accordance with section 772(a) of the Act. Normal value is calculated in accordance with section 773 of the Act. Pursuant to section 776(a) and (b) of the Act, Commerce has preliminarily relied upon facts otherwise available, with adverse inferences, for Formosa Asahi Spandex Co., Ltd (FAS). For a full description of the methodology underlying the preliminary determination, see the Preliminary Decision Memorandum.
Sections 733(d)(1)(ii) and 735(c)(5)(A) of the Act provide that in the preliminary determination, Commerce shall determine an estimated all-others rate for all exporters and producers not individually examined. This rate shall be an amount equal to the weighted average of the estimated weighted-average dumping margins established for exporters and producers individually investigated, excluding any zero and de minimis margins, and any margins determined entirely under section 776 of the Act.
In this investigation, Commerce preliminarily assigned a rate based entirely on adverse facts available to FAS. Therefore, the only rate that is not zero, de minimis or based entirely on facts otherwise available is the rate calculated for Dairen Chemical Corporation (Dairen). Consequently, the rate calculated for Dairen is also assigned as the rate for all other producers and exporters.
Commerce preliminarily determines that the following estimated weighted-average dumping margins exist:
Exporter/producer Estimated weighted- average dumping margin (percent) Dairen Chemical Corporation 7.46 Formosa Asahi Spandex Co., Ltd * 26.42 All Others 7.46 * Rate based on facts available with adverse inferences.
In accordance with section 733(d)(2) of the Act, Commerce will direct U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) to suspend liquidation of entries of subject merchandise, as described in Appendix I, entered, or withdrawn from warehouse, for consumption on or after the date of publication of this notice in the Federal Register . Further, pursuant to section 733(d)(1)(B) of the Act and 19 CFR 351.205(d), Commerce will instruct CBP to require a cash deposit equal to the estimated weighted-average dumping margin or the estimated all-others rate, as follows: (1) the cash deposit rate for the respondents listed above will be equal to the company-specific estimated weighted-average dumping margins determined in this preliminary determination; (2) if the exporter is not a respondent identified above, but the producer is, then the cash deposit rate will be equal to the company-specific estimated weighted-average dumping margin established for that producer of the subject merchandise. These suspension of liquidation instructions will remain in effect until further notice.
Commerce intends to disclose its calculations and analysis performed to interested parties in this preliminary determination within five days of any public announcement or, if there is no public announcement, within five days of the date of publication of this notice in accordance with 19 CFR 351.224(b).
Consistent with 19 CFR 351.224(e), Commerce will analyze and, if appropriate, correct any timely allegations of significant ministerial errors by amending the preliminary determination. However, consistent with 19 CFR 351.224(d), Commerce will not consider incomplete allegations that do not address the significance standard under 19 CFR 351.224(g) following the preliminary determination. Instead, Commerce will address such allegations in the final determination together with issues raised in the case briefs or other written comments.
As provided in section 782(i)(1) of the Act, Commerce intends to verify the information relied upon in making its final determination.
Non-scope related case briefs or other written comments may be submitted to the Assistant Secretary for Enforcement and Compliance no later than seven days after the date on which the last verification report is issued in this investigation. Rebuttal briefs, limited to issues raised in the case briefs, may be filed not later than five days after the date for filing case briefs.[7] Interested parties who submit case briefs or rebuttal briefs in this proceeding must submit: (1) a table of contents listing each issue; and (2) a table of authorities.[8]
As provided under 19 CFR 351.309(c)(2)(iii) and (d)(2)(iii), we request that interested parties provide at the beginning of their briefs a public, executive summary for each issue raised ( printed page 72519) in their briefs.[9] Further, we request that interested parties limit their executive summary of each issue to no more than 450 words, not including citations. We intend to use the executive summaries as the basis of the comment summaries included in the issues and decision memorandum that will accompany the final determination in this investigation. We request that interested parties include footnotes for relevant citations in the executive summary of each issue. Note that Commerce has amended certain of its requirements pertaining to the service of documents in 19 CFR 351.303(f).[10]
Pursuant to 19 CFR 351.310(c), interested parties who wish to request a hearing, limited to issues raised in the case and rebuttal briefs, must submit a written request to the Assistant Secretary for Enforcement and Compliance, U.S. Department of Commerce, within 30 days after the date of publication of this notice. Requests should contain: 1) the party's name, address, and telephone number; 2) the number of participants and whether any participant is a foreign national; and 3) a list of the issues to be discussed. If a request for a hearing is made, Commerce intends to hold the hearing at a time and date to be determined. Parties should confirm by telephone the date, time, and location of the hearing two days before the scheduled date.
Postponement of Final Determination and Extension of Provisional Measures
Section 735(a)(2) of the Act provides that a final determination may be postponed until not later than 135 days after the date of the publication of the preliminary determination if, in the event of an affirmative preliminary determination, a request for such postponement is made by exporters who account for a significant proportion of exports of the subject merchandise, or in the event of a negative preliminary determination, a request for such postponement is made by the petitioner. Section 351.210(e)(2) of Commerce's regulations requires that a request by exporters for postponement of the final determination be accompanied by a request for extension of provisional measures from a four-month period to a period not more than six months in duration.
On August 20, 2026, pursuant to 19 CFR 351.210(e), Dairen requested that Commerce postpone the final determination and that provisional measures be extended to a period not to exceed six months.[11] In accordance with section 735(a)(2)(A) of the Act and 19 CFR 351.210(b)(2)(ii), because: (1) the preliminary determination is affirmative; (2) the requesting exporter accounts for a significant proportion of exports of the subject merchandise; and (3) no compelling reasons for denial exist, Commerce is postponing the final determination and extending the provisional measures from a four-month period to a period not greater than six months. Accordingly, Commerce will make its final determination no later than 135 days after the date of publication of this preliminary determination.
U.S. International Trade Commission (ITC) Notification
In accordance with section 733(f) of the Act, Commerce will notify the ITC of its preliminary determination of sales at LTFV. If the final determination is affirmative, the ITC will determine before the later of 120 days after the date of this preliminary determination or 45 days after the final determination whether these imports are materially injuring, or threaten material injury to, the U.S. industry.
This determination is issued and published in accordance with sections 733(f) and 777(i)(1) of the Act, and 19 CFR 351.205(c).
Acting Deputy Assistant Secretary for Antidumping and Countervailing Duty Operations.
The merchandise covered by the investigation is polytetramethylene ether glycol (PTMEG), which is a polymer consisting of linear diols ( i.e., organic chemical compound that has two hydroxyl (- OH) functional groups) with a molecular backbone of repeating tetramethylene units (- CH2CH2CH2CH2-) interconnected through ether bonds ( i.e., a single oxygen atom bonded to two carbon atoms), with a chemical formula HO{(CH2)4}nOH. PTMEG is also referred to as Polytetrahydrofuran, PTHF, Polytetramethylene ether glycol, PTMG, and Polybutylene glycol. PTMEG is typically blended with butylated hydroxytoluene (BHT) or another stabilizer such as higher molecular weight hindered phenols or phosphoric acid. In addition to a stabilizer, PTMEG is sometimes blended with a modifier or additive, such as phosphoric acid or sulfuric acid. The scope includes all blends consisting of PTMEG and stabilizers, modifiers, and/or additives, where the stabilizers, modifiers, and/or additives collectively account for no more than two percent of the total weight of the PTMEG blend. PTMEG is normally associated with Chemical Abstracts Service (CAS) registry number 25190-06-1.
The scope includes all forms of PTMEG, regardless of physical form, purity, molecular weight, number of hydroxyls, number of acids, color, density, softening point, glass transition point, flash point, water content, viscosity, and packaging. PTMEG that has been blended with other products is included within this scope when such blends include constituent parts that have been intermingled but that have not been chemically reacted with each other to produce a different product. For such blends, only the PTMEG component of the mixture, inclusive of any stabilizers, modifiers, and/or additives collectively accounting for no more than two percent of the combined weight of the PTMEG component and the stabilizers, modifiers, and/or additives, is covered by the scope of the investigation.
The scope includes merchandise matching the above description that has been processed in a third country, including by commingling, diluting, introducing, or removing stabilizers, modifiers, or additives, or performing any other processing that would not otherwise remove the merchandise from the scope of the investigation if performed in the subject country. The scope also includes PTMEG that is commingled or blended with PTMEG from sources not subject to the investigation. Only the subject component of such commingled products is covered by the scope of the investigation.
The subject merchandise is classifiable in the Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States (HTSUS) under subheading 3907.29.0000. Subject merchandise may also be imported under HTSUS subheadings 2932.11.0000 and 3404.90.5150. Although the HTSUS subheading and CAS registry number are provided for convenience and customs purposes, the written description of the scope is dispositive.

content:
资料照片：美籍缅甸裔学者敏辛在尼亚加拉大瀑布留影。(照片摄于2022年4月30日，由敏辛的弟弟Aung Maw Zin提供)
美国多个人权与学术自由组织星期一(11月9日)发出一份联合声明，呼吁美国国会在本届立法会期结束前，通过由两党议员在9月份共同提出的相关决议案，要求中国立即释放美国公民兼学者敏辛(Min Zin)。牵头的弗利基金会(Foley Foundation)告诉美国之音(VOA)，国会两院若能在圣诞节休会前以口头表决方式进行审议，相关决议案有望迅速获得通过。
联合声明写道，这封致参议院多数党领袖约翰·图恩(John Thune)和众议院议长麦克·约翰逊(Mike Johnson)的信函，已于11月4日送达国会领袖手中。
声明说，该信函敦促参众两院迅速采取行动，通过今年9月由参议员埃德·马基(Ed Markey)、泰德·巴德(Ted Budd)、匡希恒(John Curtis)和亚当·希夫(Adam Schiff)提出的参议院第865号决议案以及由众议员约翰·穆勒纳尔(John Moolenaar)、斯蒂芬·林奇(Stephen Lynch)和金映玉(Young Kim)提出的众议院第1549号决议案。
这些跨党决议案谴责了中共一再任意或非法拘押美国公民的行为模式，敦促美国政府把所有在中国遭非法拘押的美国公民的平安返回当作优先事项，并敦促国务卿使用一切可以使用的工具，督促释放所有被非法或不当关押在中华人民共和国的美国公民。
这些组织在信中写道：“非法拘押无辜的美国公民绝无正当理由，必须予以最强烈的谴责。我们与敏辛先生及其家人站在一起，在他重获自由之前，我们绝不会停止努力。”
美国国务院10月19日更新了对美国公民前往中国的旅行警示，目前虽整体旅行风险仍维持二级，即“提高警觉”(Level 2-Exercise increased caution)，但是在其中加入了“D”标识(代表“非法拘押”风险)。国务院新闻发言人当时告诉美国之音(VOA)，华盛顿认定“美国人在中国面临被非法拘押的严重风险”。
美国国务院也在其官网提醒美国公民进入中国大陆时务必提高警觉，因为“当地法律的执行存在任意性，且可能在缺乏公平、透明法律程序的情况下实施出境禁令”。
美国人权与学术自由组织在联合声明中，对于美国政府在针对中国的旅行建议中加入“D”标识表示赞赏。
资料照片：在中国遭“非法拘押”的美籍缅甸裔学者敏辛(Min Zin)和妻子西尔维娅·辛(Sylvia Zin)，及女儿素(Suu)的合影。(2026年2月，照片由西尔维亚提供)
联合声明还敦促唐纳德·特朗普(Donald Trump)总统将促成敏辛的获释列为当务之急。
其它建议措施还包括将中国的旅行建议级别提升至第3级，即“重新考虑旅行”(Reconsider travel)，并附有“D”标识，以及将中国整体列入“支持非法拘押的国家”(State Sponsor of Wrongful Detention)名单。
联合声明提出，11月18日至19日中国深圳将举行亚太经合组织(APEC)峰会，12月14日至15日佛罗里达州多拉尔(Doral)将举行二十国集团(G-20)领导人峰会，相关决议若能在两个峰会之前通过，特朗普总统将获得强有力的国会授权，有助于他在与中国国家主席习近平会晤时，争取让敏辛获释。
这份联合声明由致力于救援海外被扣押美国公民的非盈利组织弗利基金会牵头，参与签署的还包括自由之家(Freedom House)、兰托斯人权与正义基金会(Lantos Foundation for Human Rights & Justice)以及学者风险网络(Scholars at Risk)等七家组织。
弗利基金会执行董事本杰明·格雷(Benjamin Gray) 在书面回复美国之音的置评请求时表示，第119届国会接近尾声，议程十分紧凑，但参议院第865号决议案和众议院第1549号决议案本身并无争议。
格雷告诉美国之音：“若能在这一期间以口头表决方式进行审议，它们(两项决议案)有望迅速获得通过。”
对于联合声明中提到的升级中国旅行建议以及把中国列为“支持非法拘押的国家”等具体措施，格雷表示，中国政府对于国会决议案或美国政府调整旅行建议等可能引发负面关注的举动非常敏感。
对于特朗普总统在接下来的两次美中领导人峰会中、再次谈及美国公民的非法拘押议题，格雷持乐观态度。他告诉美国之音：“我们预计，近期旅行建议的调整，以及我们所倡导的各项措施，将促使非法拘押美国人的议题，在未来习近平与特朗普计划进行的接触中，被列为议程的重中之重。”
敏辛是一名研究缅甸政治及中缅关系的美国学者。今年6月，他应邀赴云南参加学术会议后被中国当局拘押。北京方面指控他涉嫌从事危害中国国家安全的间谍活动。美国国务院8月20日认定敏辛遭到非法拘押。
特朗普总统9月30日曾公开透露，他一星期前与访美的习近平会晤时，谈到被中国拘押的美国公民和中国政治犯的问题。特朗普当时对记者表示：“我和习近平主席谈过，确实谈过。”
特朗普还补充道：“我们进行了交谈，我认为我们进行了一些非常、非常重要的讨论。希望这些讨论能取得成果。”
美国国务院9月30日也跟美国之音确认了相关消息。国务院发言人告诉美国之音：“特朗普政府致力于促成陈友麟(Youlin Chen))、敏辛以及所有在海外遭非法拘押的美国人获释。美国已直接向中国提出敏辛和陈博士的案件，呼吁立即释放他们。”
陈友麟是华裔美国地震学者，他2024年在北京机场准备返美时被捕，目前面临间谍罪指控。美国国务院今年3月认定他在中国遭到非法拘押。
北京此前一直否认有关中国政府进行“非法拘押”或“错误羁押”的说法，并表示中国司法机关依法办案。
VOA专访遭中国“非法拘押”的华裔科学家陈友麟妻子：“有很多人在帮助你，你很快就能回来”

content:
由美日印澳“四方安全对话”成员国派遣多艘军舰参与的“马拉巴尔 2026”海上军事演习目前持续在日本关东地区以南海域进行，演习的重点在于强化印太区域内的反潜及反水面作战。美国第七舰队表示，此次演习旨在支持“自由开放的印太地区”，并强化各方共同维护地区稳定、安全与繁荣，以及威慑侵略者的决心。
“马拉巴尔 2026”海上军事演习的主办单位日本海上自卫队9日在官方X平台上贴出短片，并附上贴文表示，“通过此次由海上自卫队主办的演习，我们将进一步加强与各参演国之间的合作，共同致力于实现“自由开放的印度太平洋”。
“马拉巴尔 2026”演习于11月5日开始持续到12日，在横须贺海军基地周边海域及岸上展开演练。
本次演习中，美国派出两栖船坞运输舰“安克雷奇”号 (USS Anchorage, LPD-23)和“约翰·P·穆尔萨”号，以及P-8A“海神”反潜巡逻机。
日本海上自卫队派出直升机驱逐舰“伊势”号 (JS Ise)、护卫舰“最上”号 (JS Mogami)、一艘苍龙级潜艇以及 P-1 反潜巡逻机。
印度派出东部舰队的国产导弹隐身护卫舰“萨亚德里号” (INS Sahyadri)。
澳大利亚派出护卫舰“斯图尔特”号 (HMAS Stuart)和 P-8A“海神”反潜巡逻机。
演练科目涵盖反潜战 (ASW)、反水面战 (ASUW)、防空与网络防御、以及多国海上联合协调行动等全方位多领域训练。
今年是“马拉巴尔”演习的30周年，也是美日印澳四国第6次共同参与“马拉巴尔”演习。
美国第七舰队司令帕特·汉尼芬（Pat Hannifin）中将表示，“‘马拉巴尔’演习始于1992年，最初只是美印之间一项规模较小的双边活动；经过30年的发展，现已演变为一场顶级的四边演习。这种发展提升了我们的互操作性，使我们能够携手巩固一个造福各国的‘自由开放的印太地区’。”
10月底在美国亚特兰大举行的“四方安全对话”外长会议中也决定，基于今年5月达成的“印太海上监视协作倡议”框架，四国将在2027年举行第一次“海龙2027”（Sea Dragon 2027）演习，以加强信息共享和海域态势感知。

卢比奥国务卿在巴黎与七国集团的盟友举行了为期两天的会谈后向记者表示，美国暂时搁置军事行动并不代表陷入僵局。卢比奥国务卿说：“我们的经济行动，以及由此对伊朗政权施加的压力和造成的经济破坏，效果非常显著，以至于总统实际上已经没有必要再发动大规模军事行动。当然，如果伊朗触碰某些红线，或者伊朗政权采取某些不应该发生的行动，我不会具体推测这些情况是什么，但你们知道我指的是什么，美国军方作为世界上最具作战能力的军队，随时准备采取行动应对。”
卢比奥国务卿强调，在美军暂停打击的同时，美国对伊朗的经济制裁仍将持续加强，随着伊朗仅存的石油库存耗尽，美国财政部长贝森特也正在与情报机构合作，致力防堵伊朗规避制裁的漏洞。
而谈到美中之间的大国竞争，卢比奥国务卿重申，他对美中之间在各个议题上的分歧与中国的体制，始终保持务实而清醒的态度：“我们并非为全球秩序服务，也不是为其他国家效力；我们是为美国服务。在处理各类政策议题时，无论是涉及我们与其他国家的双边关系，还是人工智能的发展，我们始终将美国及其人民的利益置于一切之上。这往往使我们与包括中国在内的其他国家产生分歧或冲突。我们对此保持务实而清醒的态度。我是在为美国工作，总统也在为美国而战。在任何议题上，我们永远都会站在美国这一边。”
至于有媒体报道，卢比奥国务卿对英伟达CEO黄仁勋的婚外情可能涉及中共间谍与美中科技竞争，事先知情，并监督起草一份备忘录向特朗普政府高层发出警告，在巴黎面对记者追问此事时，卢比奥国务卿回应称，无法对相关报道发表评论。

2026 年 11 月 10 日，在与可能弹劾国防部长皮特·赫格斯 (Pete Hegseth) 相关的程序性投票之前，一名孤独的抗议者在美国国会大厦前举着“弹劾赫格斯”的牌子。（乔纳森·恩斯特/路透社）
众议院周二晚上投票决定将针对国防部长皮特·赫格塞斯的弹劾条款提交给众议院司法委员会，从而有效地驳回了罢免赫格塞斯内阁职务的努力。
众议院共和党人以 211 比 204 票否决了肯塔基州共和党众议员托马斯·马西提出的弹劾赫格斯塞斯的提议。马西指控赫格赛斯在处理加勒比和太平洋地区的缉毒行动和法外处决过程中疏忽大意，并进行了非法活动； 2月份未经国会批准袭击伊朗；对亚利桑那州民主党参议员马克·凯利（Mark Kelly）进行报复，因为这位资深议员根据非法命令向部队发表了言论；在未宣战的情况下俘获委内瑞拉总统尼古拉斯·马杜罗；及其他操作。
文章称，“国防部长彼得·赫格斯的这种行为表明，如果允许他继续留任，他将仍然对宪法构成威胁，而且他的行为方式与他的职责和法治严重不相容。”
将这些条款发送给司法委员会的决定可能会将投票推迟到一月份，届时民主党将在国会占据多数席位。
截至周四，民主党在众议院赢得了 256 个席位，共和党赢得了 168 个席位，而在参议院，民主党至少拥有 54 个席位，而共和党则拥有 44 个席位。
如果众议院明年投票弹劾赫格塞斯，则任何条款都需要三分之二多数才能迫使赫格塞斯下台。
在周二早上投票前举行的一次罕见的新闻发布会上，赫格斯称马西为“心怀不满和失败的国会议员”，试图“损害这位总统、这个国家，以及最不负责任的捍卫国家的战士”。
赫格塞斯指出，唐纳德·特朗普总统曾两次被弹劾，但并未被定罪，他表示，他将“一周中的每一天都接管该公司”。
“这些决议是一场闹剧。他们嘲笑宪法。他们攻击指挥系统，并将执行合法命令的战士定为犯罪，”赫格塞斯说。
特朗普表示，他将支持国防部长，周一称他“做得非常好”。
如果这一努力成功，这将标志着美国国防部长的第二次弹劾和内阁成员的第三次弹劾。 2024 年，国土安全部部长亚历杭德罗·马约卡斯因总统乔·拜登在美墨边境的移民政策而被弹劾。参议院在审判前投票驳回了这些指控。
1876 年，战争部长威廉·贝尔纳普 (William Belknap) 在辞职后不久就因腐败指控而遭到弹劾。后来他在参议院被无罪释放。

A lone protester holds an “Impeach Hegseth” sign on the grounds of the U.S. Capitol ahead of a procedural vote related to the potential impeachment of Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth on Nov. 10, 2026. (Jonathan Ernst/Reuters)
The House voted Tuesday evening to send the proposed impeachment articles against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth to the House Judiciary Committee, effectively quashing an effort to oust Hegseth from his cabinet post.
In a 211 to 204 vote, House Republicans sidestepped an effort proposed by Republican Rep. Thomas Massie of Kentucky to impeach Hegseth. Massie charged that Hegseth was negligent and conducted illegal activity in his handling of counternarcotics operations and extrajudicial killings in the Caribbean and Pacific; attacking Iran in February without congressional approval; retaliating against Sen. Mark Kelly, D-Ariz., for the veteran lawmaker’s statements to troops on illegal orders; capturing Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro without a declaration of war; and other operations.
“Secretary of Defense Peter Hegseth, by such conduct, has demonstrated that he will remain a threat to the Constitution if allowed to remain in office, and has acted in a manner grossly incompatible with his duties and the rule of law,” the articles stated.
The decision to send the articles to the Judiciary Committee likely delays the vote until January, when Democrats take over the majority in Congress.
As of Thursday, Democrats won 256 seats in the House to the Republicans’ 168, while in the Senate, Democrats have at least 54 seats to 44 Republican seats.
If the House votes to impeach Hegseth next year, a two-thirds majority would be needed on any of the articles to force Hegseth out of office.
In a rare news conference Tuesday morning before the vote, Hegseth called Massie a “disgruntled and defeated congressman” seeking to “do damage to this president, this country, and most irresponsibly, the warriors who defend it.”
Noting that President Donald Trump was impeached twice but not convicted, Hegseth said he would “take that company every day of the week.”
“These resolutions are a farce. They mock the Constitution. They attack the chain of command, and they criminalize the warfighters who execute lawful orders,” Hegseth said.
Trump has said he would stand by his defense secretary, saying Monday that he’s “done a very good job.”
If the effort had succeeded, it would have marked the second impeachment of a U.S. defense secretary and third of a cabinet member. In 2024, Homeland Security Secretary Alejandro Mayorkas was impeached over President Joe Biden’s immigration policies at the U.S.-Mexico border. The Senate voted to dismiss the charges before it went to trial.
Secretary of War William Belknap was impeached in 1876 on corruption charges shortly after he resigned. He was later acquitted in the Senate.
A survey released in October by the military-veterans advocacy non-profit Common Defense found that troops and family members are uncomfortable with what they see as the politicization of the armed forces.
According to the survey, conducted by Change Research, 54% of active-duty personnel surveyed disapproved of Hegseth, while 64% of military family members disapproved.
A majority of the group of 731 active-duty troops, veterans and military family members also believe decisions within the department were being made for political gain, and 53% of active-duty personnel said the politicization was making them want to leave the military sooner than anticipated.
Nearly half the active-duty personnel also said they oppose Operation Epic Fury, the United States’ operation against Iran.
Patricia Kime is a senior writer covering military and veterans health care, medicine and personnel issues.

title: Chinese woman accused of spying on Nvidia boss entered Taiwan on Hong Kong passport
zh_title: 被指控监视英伟达老板的中国女子持香港护照进入台湾
summary: 台湾移民机构周三表示，在当局调查这一事件时，这名被指控在与英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋有染期间为中国从事间谍活动的女子使用香港护照进入台湾。这张来自 CTI 视频片段的屏幕截图显示，爱丽丝·黄（右二，粉红色）于 2025 年 5 月 22 日在台北一家餐厅参加由 Nvidia 首席执行官兼联合创始人黄仁勋（左二，黑色后置摄像头）举办的晚宴。照片：法新社。据报道，黄仁勋承认与新加坡 Megaspeed w 的中国前高管 Alice Huang 有染。
content:
台湾移民机构周三表示，在当局调查这一事件时，这名被指控在与英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋有染期间为中国从事间谍活动的女子使用香港护照进入台湾。这张来自 CTI 视频片段的屏幕截图显示，爱丽丝·黄（右二，粉红色）于 2025 年 5 月 22 日在台北一家餐厅参加由 Nvidia 首席执行官兼联合创始人黄仁勋（左二，黑色后置摄像头）举办的晚宴。照片：法新社。据报道，黄仁勋承认与新加坡Megaspeed公司前中国高管爱丽丝·黄(Alice Huang)有染，美国官员认为她为中国情报部门工作。北京否认了间谍指控。英伟达董事会周日宣布，已对该公司首席执行官兼联合创始人黄仁勋展开调查，他与黄爱丽没有任何关系。入出国及移民署署长林弘恩对记者表示，“我国政府相关机构已充分了解相关记录和信息”，并证实黄丽娟使用香港护照进入台湾。 “我们知道她所有的相关出入境记录。”一般来说，香港护照持有者比持有中国大陆护照的人更容易进入台湾，后者还必须申请特别许可才能前往台湾。额外的限制部分是由于中国与台湾之间的复杂关系，北京声称并誓言要将台湾置于其控制之下。
积极调查 台湾内政部长刘世芳表示，黄爱丽“确实入境了，但她目前在海外”。“如果我们知道她是间谍，我们肯定不会让她进入台湾，”刘在国会告诉议员。她说：“我们将审查我们的程序，特别是预筛选、临时抽查和访谈以及访问后措施。” “据我们了解，这名黄女士的通行证已被吊销，这意味着她不可能再次进入台湾。”黄仁勋于 2025 年 10 月 31 日在庆州庆州艺术中心举行的亚太经济合作组织 (APEC) 首席执行官峰会上发表演讲。照片：Anthony Wallace/法新社。台湾官员拒绝透露黄爱丽访问台湾的日期，也拒绝透露她访问台湾的次数。刘周二表示，台湾“国家安全部门正在积极调查此事”。 2025 年 5 月，台湾顶级科技博览会台北国际电脑展期间，黄仁勋 (Alice Huang)，又名黄乐 (Huang Le)，出席了黄仁勋在台北一家中餐厅举办的晚宴。记者站在餐厅外，透过玻璃门窗拍摄黄仁勋和一名身穿粉色连衣裙、名叫爱丽丝·黄 (Alice Huang) 的女子与其他与会者混在一起的情况。媒体直播显示，有一次，黄仁勋用手臂搂住黄爱丽，而她亲吻了他的右脸颊。

【原文 English Original】
The woman accused of spying for China during an affair with Nvidia chief Jensen Huang used a Hong Kong passport to enter Taiwan, the island’s immigration agency said Wednesday, as authorities investigate the incident. This screengrab from video footage by CTI shows Alice Huang (2nd R in pink) attending a dinner hosted by Nvidia’s chief executive and co-founder Jensen Huang (2nd L in black back facing camera) at a restaurant in Taipei on May 22, 2025. Photo: AFP. Jensen Huang has admitted to having an affair, reportedly with Alice Huang, a Chinese former executive at Singapore-based Megaspeed who US officials believe was working for Chinese intelligence. Beijing has rejected the spying allegations. Nvidia’s board announced Sunday that it had opened a probe into Jensen Huang, the company’s chief executive and co-founder, who is no relation to Alice Huang. “Our government’s relevant agencies are fully informed of the relevant records and information,” National Immigration Agency Director-General Lin Horng-en told reporters, confirming that Alice Huang used a Hong Kong passport to enter Taiwan. “We were aware of all her relevant entry and exit records.” It is generally easier for Hong Kong passport holders to enter Taiwan than those with mainland Chinese passports, who must also apply for special permission to travel there. The additional restrictions are partly due to the complex relations between China and Taiwan, which Beijing claims and has vowed to bring under its control. Active investigation Taiwan’s Interior Minister Liu Shyh-fang said Alice Huang “did indeed enter the country, but she is currently overseas”. “If we had known she was a spy, we certainly would not have let her enter Taiwan,” Liu told lawmakers in parliament. “We will review our procedures, specifically our pre-screening, interim spot checks and interviews, and post-visit measures,” she said. “As far as we understand, this Ms Huang has had her permit revoked, meaning it is impossible for her to enter Taiwan again.” Jensen Huang delivers a speech during the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) CEO Summit at the Gyeongju Arts Center in Gyeongju on October 31, 2025. Photo: Anthony Wallace/AFP. Taiwanese officials refused to share the dates of Alice Huang’s trips to Taiwan or say how many times she had visited. On Tuesday, Liu said Taiwan’s “national security units are actively investigating the matter”. Alice Huang, also known as Huang Le, was seen at a dinner in May 2025 hosted by Jensen Huang at a Chinese restaurant in Taipei during Computex, the island’s top tech expo. Journalists stood outside the restaurant filming through glass windows and doors as Jensen Huang and a woman identified as Alice Huang, who was wearing a pink dress, mingled with other attendees. At one point, Jensen Huang can be seen putting his arm around Alice Huang as she kisses him on the right cheek, press livestreams show.

title: Ex-lawmaker William Wong pleads guilty to drink driving and failing to stop after CUHK crash
zh_title: 前立法会议员黄威廉承认醉酒驾驶及中大车祸后未能停车
summary: 前立法会议员黄威廉在六月发生的事件导致他辞去立法会议员职务后，承认酒后驾驶和交通事故后未能停车的罪名。香港立法会议员黄威廉出席 2026 年 7 月 1 日庆祝回归周年纪念仪式。照片：黄威廉，来自 Facebook。黄先生周三在沙田裁判法院提出抗辩。这名66岁的男子被控酒精浓度超过规定限度驾驶、粗心驾驶、发生事故后未停车、以及未报告涉及重大事故的罪名。
content:
前立法会议员黄威廉在六月发生的事件导致他辞去立法会议员职务后，承认酒后驾驶和交通事故后未能停车的罪名。香港立法会议员黄威廉出席 2026 年 7 月 1 日庆祝回归周年纪念仪式。照片：黄威廉，来自 Facebook。黄先生周三在沙田裁判法院提出抗辩。这名66岁的男子被指控酒精浓度超过规定限度驾驶、粗心驾驶、发生事故后未停车以及未报告造成损害的事故。这些指控均与6月29日在香港中文大学（中大）发生的一起事件有关。警方称，身兼该大学工程系副院长的黄某当晚撞到了中大宿舍外停放的两辆汽车。事故发生后，黄离开了现场，但后来返回接受调查，期间他未能通过酒精测试。 2025 年 9 月 10 日，香港立法会议员谢保罗在立法会恢复同性伴侣法案辩论之际发表讲话。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。同为前立法会议员的谢保罗在法庭上代表黄。据当地媒体报道，他宣读了一份长达近 45 分钟的缓刑声明，称黄先生品格良好，拥有 33 年服务社会的经验。
这位大律师提交了包括前政务司司长唐英年和前交通运输局长陈帆在内的政治重量级人物的缓刑信。立法会议员邵彼得和邱达根也写了信。律师呼吁非监禁判决 黄先生于2022年通过补选当选立法会议员，填补立法机构的四个空缺。此次补选是小圈投票，只有由政治精英组成的选举委员会成员才能投票。他在 2025 年立法会选举中再次当选。黄威廉于 2022 年 12 月 19 日在立法会宣誓。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。交通事故发生几天后，他辞去立法会议员职务，并为给社会带来“麻烦”而道歉。香港中文大学还暂停了黄先生的工程学院外事副院长职务，尽管该大学网站仍将他列为教授。谢在求情时还表示，一位朋友提出当晚开车送黄家回家，但黄拒绝了，因为他不想占用他们的时间。谢说，黄还患有睡眠呼吸暂停症，当时非常疲倦，导致他失去了判断力。谢辩称，监禁将是一种“不成比例的惩罚”，并要求法院考虑社区服务令或缓刑——一种被告不必服刑的刑罚，除非他们在指定期限内再次犯罪。

【原文 English Original】
Ex-lawmaker William Wong has pleaded guilty to drink driving and failing to stop after a traffic accident, following an incident in June that prompted his resignation from the Legislative Council. Hong Kong lawmaker William Wong attends a ceremony to celebrate the handover anniversary on July 1, 2026. Photo: William Wong, via Facebook. Wong entered his plea at Sha Tin Magistrates’ Courts on Wednesday. The 66-year-old was charged with driving with alcohol concentration above the prescribed limit, careless driving, failing to stop after an accident, and failing to report an accident involving damage. The charges all relate to an incident at the Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) on June 29. Wong, who was also an associate dean at the university’s engineering faculty, hit two parked cars outside a CUHK residential hall that night, police said. Wong left the scene after the accident but later returned for an investigation, during which he failed a breathalyser test. Hong Kong lawmaker Paul Tse speaks on September 10, 2025, as the Legislative Council resumes debate for a same-sex partnership bill. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Paul Tse, also a former lawmaker, represented Wong in court. He read out a mitigation statement lasting nearly 45 minutes, saying that Wong was a person of good character and had 33 years of experience serving society, local media reported . The barrister submitted mitigation letters from political heavyweights including former chief secretary Henry Tang and former transport chief Frank Chan. Lawmakers Peter Shiu and Duncan Chiu also wrote letters. Lawyer urges non-custodial sentence Wong was elected to the Legislative Council in 2022 via a by-election to fill four vacancies in the lawmaking body. The by-election was a small-circle vote in which only members of the Election Committee, a body composed of political elites, could vote. He was re-elected during the Legislative Council elections in 2025. William Wong takes an oath at the Legislative Council on Dec. 19, 2022. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Days after the traffic incident, he stepped down as a lawmaker and apologised for bringing “trouble” to society. CUHK also suspended Wong from his position as the engineering faculty’s external affairs associate dean, although the university website still lists him as a professor. Tse also said during mitigation that a friend had offered to drive Wong home that night, but Wong declined as he did not want to take up their time. Wong also had sleep apnoea and was extremely tired at the time, causing him to lose his sense of judgement, Tse said. Tse argued that imprisonment would be a “disproportionate punishment,” and asked the court to consider a community service order or a suspended sentence – a type of penalty where the defendant does not have to serve the jail term unless they reoffend within a specified period.

title: ‘A Symphony of Lights’ to dim for good next Wednesday after 22-year run
zh_title: 连续演出 22 年后，《幻彩咏香江》将于下周三永久熄灭
summary: 香港旅游发展局宣布，香港长达 10 分钟的灯光音响表演《幻彩咏香江》定于下周三上演最后一场演出，这是在香港天际线上演 22 年后的最后一场演出。 2026 年 2 月 26 日，游客在尖沙咀观看表演《幻彩咏香江》。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。商人兼香港旅游发展局（旅发局）主席林建岳在周二的新闻发布会上表示，《幻彩咏香江》将在下周三上演最后一场演出后退役。最后的表演将采用额外的烟火元素来纪念这位特殊的妈妈
content:
香港旅游发展局宣布，香港长达 10 分钟的灯光音响表演《幻彩咏香江》定于下周三上演最后一场演出，这是在香港天际线上演 22 年后的最后一场演出。 2026 年 2 月 26 日，游客在尖沙咀观看表演《幻彩咏香江》。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。商人兼香港旅游发展局（旅发局）主席林建岳在周二的新闻发布会上表示，《幻彩咏香江》将在下周三上演最后一场演出后退役。林说，最后的演出将采用额外的烟火元素来纪念这一特殊时刻。政府于二月宣布，计划以在山顶等不同地点举行的其他灯光主题表演取代长期举行的维港灯光秀。从 2004 年开始，这项每日免费的灯光秀涉及天际线上的 43 座建筑，并于 2005 年被吉尼斯世界纪录授予“最大的永久性灯光和声音秀”称号。据香港媒体报道，近年来，随着其他城市推出更大规模的灯光秀，游客认为该灯光秀已经过时且不起眼。旅发局原计划在太平山顶安装灯光秀，以取代长期举行的灯光秀。然而，由于该提案遭到步道使用者和居民的批评，旅游局于 11 月初取消了该计划。林郑月娥周二表示，旅发局将于明年推出新的灯光秀。
WinterFest扩展至三地 林郑月娥周二还宣布，旅发局将于下周三至1月5日举办一年一度的节庆活动“WinterFest”。该活动首次扩展至中环、尖沙咀和铜锣湾三个地点，每个地点都会在圣诞假期期间呈现不同主题的灯光秀。中环2026冬日节的设计概念。照片：香港旅游发展局。林郑月娥周二发表声明称：“多年来，香港冬日节为公众带来欢乐的节日氛围。去年，我们首次与置地公司合作，在中环呈现香港冬日乐园，并与中环多个地标合作举办沉浸式灯光秀，深受市民和旅客欢迎。”主席表示，旅游局将与希慎慎兴合作，在铜锣湾引入装置和灯光秀，而尖沙咀的活动将由香港保诚集团赞助。

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong’s 10-minute light and sound show, “A Symphony of Lights,” is scheduled to stage its final show next Wednesday after a 22-year presence on the city’s skyline, the Hong Kong Tourism Board has announced. Tourists watching the show “A Symphony of Lights” in Tsim Sha Tsui on February 26, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Peter Lam, businessman and chair of the Hong Kong Tourism Board (HKTB), said at a press conference on Tuesday that “A Symphony of Lights” would be retired after staging its last show next Wednesday. The final show would feature extra pyrotechnic elements to mark the special moment, Lam said. The government announced in February plans to replace the long-running harbour light show with other light-themed shows in different locations, such as the Peak. Starting in 2004, the free, daily light show – involving 43 buildings across the skyline – was awarded the “Largest Permanent Light and Sound Show” title by the Guinness Book of Records in 2005. In recent years, the show has been considered outdated and unimpressive by tourists as other cities rolled out larger-scale light shows, HKFP reported in March. The HKTB had planned to replace the long-running light show with an installation on the Peak. However, the tourism authority called off the plan in early November after the proposal drew criticism from trail users and residents . Lam said on Tuesday that the HKTB would roll out new light shows next year. WinterFest extended to 3 locales Lam also announced on Tuesday that the HKTB would run its annual festive event, WinterFest, from next Wednesday until January 5. For the first time, the event would be extended to three locations including Central, Tsim Sha Tsui and Causeway Bay, with each featuring light shows of different themes during the Christmas holiday. Design concept of 2026 WinterFest in Central. Photo: HKTB. “Over the years, Hong Kong WinterFest has brought a joyful festive atmosphere to the public. Last year, we partnered with Hongkong Land for the first time to present Hong Kong Winter Wonderland in Central, along with an immersive light show staged in collaboration with a number of Central landmarks, which proved hugely popular with locals and visitors alike,” Lam said in a statement issued on Tuesday. The chair said the tourism authority would collaborate with Hysan to introduce installations and light shows in Causeway Bay, while the Tsim Sha Tsui event would be sponsored by Prudential Hong Kong.

title: Hong Kong cuts Northern Link railway budget by 28% through mainland-referenced standards
zh_title: 香港参照内地标准削减北环线铁路预算28%
summary: 政府表示，一条新铁路线将成为加强香港与内地邻近城市联系的基础设施大型项目的交通骨干，耗资约862亿港元，比最初的估计下降了四分之一以上。 2026 年 10 月 13 日，以深圳天际线为背景的大片土地即将成为香港的北部大都市。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。政府与港铁公司签署了关于北环线的协议，这是一个连接现有线路和铁路线的铁路项目。
content:
政府表示，一条新铁路线将成为加强香港与内地邻近城市联系的基础设施大型项目的交通骨干，耗资约862亿港元，比最初的估计下降了四分之一以上。 2026 年 10 月 13 日，以深圳天际线为背景的大片土地即将成为香港的北部大都市。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。政府与港铁公司就北环线签署了一项协议，该铁路项目连接现有线路并提供通往中国大陆边境的额外通道。运输及物流局局长陈美宝在周二的仪式上表示，成本削减的部分原因是香港采用了“香港铁路标准”，这是一套参考中国大陆使用的标准的新标准。新标准于今年2月颁布，“引入最适合我国和世界各地的铁路标准，促进创新技术、材料、设备和系统的广泛采用。”陈还指出，拟议立法中的“各种精简提案”旨在减少北部大都市（该市北部的一个大型开发项目）规划、土地管理和监管程序方面的繁文缛节。
北部都会区的“支柱” 该都会区项目旨在深化香港与中国大陆的融合，将约300平方公里（约占香港土地面积的三分之一）转变为创新和科技中心。另请参阅：科技城到大学城：为什么香港北部都会区将重点从高科技转向高等教育 陈表示，将铁路项目的两个组成部分（干线和支线）捆绑在一起将有助于降低成本并提前完成时间表。声明称，以2025年7月价格计算，整个项目的资本成本估计约为862亿港元，较原来估计低28%。运输及物流局局长陈美洁（后右）与地铁公司主席甘雅各布（后左）、运输及物流局常任秘书长邱腾华（前右二）及地铁公司行政总裁杨洁妮（前左二）于2026年11月10日合照。图片：香港政府一站通。周二的一份声明称：“通过上述突破，再加上缩短工期带来的成本节约效益，整个北环线项目的整体建设成本比原预算降低了28%。”
声明还表示，行政长官已将北部都会计划下开发的八幅土地批予港铁公司，包括牛潭尾、新田、古洞北的地块，以及凹头的住宅地块。港铁公司是政府持有多数股权的铁路公司，将以“铁路加地产”的模式开发住宅和商业用途，利用房地产开发收入支持铁路运营。

【原文 English Original】
A new railway line meant to be the transport backbone for an infrastructure megaproject strengthening Hong Kong’s ties with neighbouring mainland cities will cost about HK$86.2 billion – down more than a quarter from original estimates, the government has said. Tracts of land that will soon become Hong Kong’s Northern Metropolis, pictured with the Shenzhen skyline in the background on October 13, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The announcement accompanied the signing of an agreement between the government and the MTR Corporation on the Northern Link, a railway project connecting existing lines and providing an additional link to the mainland Chinese border. The slashed costs were attributed, in part, to the city’s adoption of the “Hong Kong Railway Standards,” a new set of standards taking reference from those used in mainland China, Secretary for Transport and Logistics Mable Chan said at the Tuesday ceremony. The new standards were promulgated this February, “introducing the most suitable railway standards of the nation and various places in the world to facilitate the wider adoption of innovative technologies, materials, equipment and systems.” Chan also pointed to “various streamlining proposals” under proposed legislation meant to cut the red tape around planning, land administration, and regulatory procedures in the Northern Metropolis, a development megaproject in the city’s north. ‘Backbone’ of Northern Metropolis The metropolis project is meant to deepen Hong Kong’s integration with mainland China, transforming about 300 square kilometres — roughly a third of the city’s land — into an innovation and technology hub. See also: Technopole to University Towns: Why Hong Kong’s Northern Metropolis shifted focus from hi-tech to higher ed Chan said bundling the two components of the rail project — the Main Line and the Spur Line — would help reduce costs and advance the completion timetable. The statement said that the capital cost of the entire project was estimated at about HK$86.2 billion in July 2025 prices, lower than the original estimate by 28 per cent. Secretary for Transport and Logistics Mable Chan (back, right), and MTRC Chairman, Jacob Kam (back, left), Permanent Secretary for Transport and Logistics Vic Yau (front, second right), and MTRC CEO, Jeny Yeung (front, second left), on November 10, 2026. Photo: GovHK. “Through the above breakthroughs, coupled with the cost-saving benefits brought about by the shortened construction period, the overall construction cost of the whole Northern Link Project has been reduced by 28 per cent as compared with the original estimate,” a statement on Tuesday read. The statement also said that the chief executive had granted eight plots of land tapped for development under the Northern Metropolis scheme to the MTR Corporation, including sites in Ngau Tam Mei, San Tin, Kwu Tung North, and a residential plot in Au Tau. The railway operator, in which the government holds a majority stake, would develop the plots for residential and commercial use under the “rail-plus-property” model, which leverages income from property developments to support railway operations.

title: Nvidia CEO affair revives push for tougher US line on China
zh_title: 英伟达首席执行官事件再次推动美国对华采取更强硬立场
summary: 英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋的丑闻可能会在华盛顿产生最严重的后果，华盛顿对华鹰派人士正利用这一事件来推动在唐纳德·特朗普总统领导下搁置的强硬路线。 2025 年 4 月 30 日星期三，在白宫十字厅举行的“投资美国”活动中，NVIDIA 首席执行官黄仁勋在唐纳德·特朗普总统的注视下发表讲话。照片：白宫，来自 Flickr。黄仁勋是英伟达的联合创始人，并将其发展成为全球领先的人工智能处理器供应商，他在
content:
英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋的丑闻可能会在华盛顿产生最严重的后果，华盛顿对华鹰派人士正利用这一事件来推动在唐纳德·特朗普总统领导下搁置的强硬路线。 2025 年 4 月 30 日星期三，在白宫十字厅举行的“投资美国”活动中，NVIDIA 首席执行官黄仁勋在唐纳德·特朗普总统的注视下发表讲话。照片：白宫，来自 Flickr。黄仁勋是英伟达的联合创始人，并将其发展成为全球领先的人工智能处理器供应商。他周日承认与新加坡 Megaspeed 前高管爱丽丝·黄 (Alice Huang) 有染，美国情报官员认为她为中国情报部门工作。特朗普一直依赖黄作为人工智能顾问，称他是“一个值得尊敬的人”，并表示黄告诉他，他不知道这名女子是间谍。黄仁勋多年来一直游说反对限制向中国销售先进人工智能芯片，而特朗普去年在两党鹰派的反对下批准了英伟达 H200 芯片向中国出口。战略与国际研究中心的阿洛克·梅塔表示：“华盛顿政策圈子里的对华鹰派对这些决定感到非常沮丧，他们确实希望看到针对中国的出口管制采取更积极的做法。” “他们现在将看到他们努力的一些成果。” Nvidia 的 H200 芯片。照片：英伟达。
华盛顿的许多人认为，美国与中国陷入了冷战式的技术和军事主导地位竞赛，而这些鹰派人士对特朗普不遵守这一点感到愤怒。美国前副国务卿、咨询公司亚洲集团联合创始人库尔特·坎贝尔表示：“我们正在进行的调查工作是相当长一段时间内最严肃的调查工作之一。”坎贝尔说，议员们想知道政府何时得知所谓的联系、总统是否受到警告以及这些联系是否影响了他的对华政策。据《纽约时报》报道，国务卿马可·卢比奥五月份向特朗普证实了这些指控，但总统选择不采取行动。另请参阅：中国如何获得开发人工智能所需的 Nvidia 芯片 据《华盛顿邮报》报道，在获得特朗普批准恢复对华芯片销售几个月后，Nvidia 向特朗普的白宫宴会厅承诺了 2500 万美元，这是最大的一笔捐款。英伟达表示，这份礼物与其商业利益无关。三名共和党众议院委员会主席要求黄出席 11 月 18 日举行的闭门简报会，内容涉及他与 Alice Huang 的交易以及 Nvidia 的反间谍保障措施。布鲁金斯学会约翰·L·桑顿中国中心研究员凯尔·陈(Kyle Chan)表示，共和党人长期以来一直担心与特朗普作对，这并非“无敌”。
但陈告诉法新社，随着该党失去对国会的控制，特朗普“不再是这个看似无敌的政治品牌”，一些人可能会更自由地与他决裂。这可能会重启《人工智能监督法案》，这是一项两党法案，允许国会审查和阻止向中国和其他对手出口先进人工智能芯片的许可证。密涅瓦科技期货公司策略主管艾米丽·本森表示，这些披露给鹰派带来了“新的热情”，以推动陷入僵局的年度国防授权法案，并附加出口管制措施。她说，关键问题是特朗普，他拥有参众两院只有三分之二多数票才能推翻的否决权。商务部工作人员

【原文 English Original】
The scandal engulfing Nvidia chief executive Jensen Huang could have its biggest consequences in Washington, where China hawks are seizing on the affair to push a hard line that had been put on the back burner under President Donald Trump. NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang delivers remarks as President Donald Trump looks on during an “Investing in America” event, Wednesday, April 30, 2025, in the Cross Hall of the White House. Photo: The White House, via Flickr. Huang, who co-founded Nvidia and turned it into the world’s leading supplier of the processors that power artificial intelligence, admitted on Sunday to an affair with Alice Huang , a former executive at Singapore-based Megaspeed whom US intelligence officials believe was working for Chinese intelligence. Trump, who has relied on Huang as an adviser on AI, called him “an honorable guy” and said Huang told him he had no idea the woman was a spy. Huang has spent years lobbying against curbs on sales of advanced AI chips to China, and Trump last year cleared Nvidia’s H200 chips for export there over objections from hawks in both parties. “China hawks in policy circles in Washington DC were quite frustrated with the decisions and really wanted to see a more aggressive approach around export controls to China,” said Aalok Mehta of the Center for Strategic and International Studies. “They will now see some fruits of their efforts.” Nvidia’s H200 chips. Photo: Nvidia. Many in Washington see the United States as locked in a Cold War-style race with China for technological and military dominance, and these hawks have bristled at Trump not conforming to that. “What we are heading into is one of the most serious investigative efforts in a substantial period,” said Kurt Campbell, a former US deputy secretary of state and co-founder of consultancy The Asia Group. Lawmakers will want to know when the government learned of the alleged links, whether the president was warned and whether the contacts shaped his China policy, Campbell said. The New York Times has reported that Secretary of State Marco Rubio confirmed the allegations to Trump in May, but the president chose not to act. See also: How China gets the Nvidia chips it needs to develop AI Nvidia committed $25 million to Trump’s White House ballroom — among the largest donations — months after securing his approval to resume chip sales to China, The Washington Post reported. Nvidia has said the gift was independent of its business interests. Three Republican House committee chairs have asked Huang to attend a closed-door briefing on November 18 about his dealings with Alice Huang and Nvidia’s safeguards against espionage. Not ‘invincible’ Kyle Chan, a fellow at the Brookings Institution’s John L. Thornton China Center, said Republicans long feared crossing Trump. But with the party having lost control of Congress and Trump “no longer this seemingly invincible political brand,” some may feel freer to break with him, Chan told AFP. That could revive the AI Overwatch Act, a bipartisan bill that would let Congress review and block licenses to export advanced AI chips to China and other adversaries. The revelations have given hawks “new enthusiasm” to push through the stalled annual defense authorization bill with export control measures attached, said Emily Benson, head of strategy at Minerva Technology Futures. The key question is Trump, she said, who holds a veto that only two-thirds majorities in both chambers can override. Commerce Department staff have also pushed for new rules, including curbs on Chinese remote access to advanced AI chips, but Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick will not act without Trump’s instruction, tech news outlet The Information reported. The department has already drawn scrutiny for reportedly halting a probe into Megaspeed’s dealings with Nvidia. Tighter rules risk upsetting the trade truce Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping reached last year. Chinese President Xi Jinping (right) ​paid a state visit ‌to the US between September 23 and 25 at the invitation of President Donald Trump (right). Photo: White House. Export control legislation seen by Beijing as targeting China “would almost certainly invite swift retaliatory action by Beijing to destabilize US supply chains,” Benson said. The FBI is looking into the spying allegations, Trump said, while the Justice Department is investigating whether Megaspeed smuggled Nvidia chips into China, NBC News reported. Megaspeed denies smuggling, and Beijing has dismissed the spying claims as smears. If wrongdoing were found and Huang forced out, “that would have huge implications for AI in the US, given that he has played such a pivotal role in pushing forward Nvidia but also the whole industry,” Chan said. But even short of Huang’s downfall, “Nvidia’s traction within the halls of Congress and within the administration is likely to be significantly reduced or completely eliminated,” Mehta said.

title: HKFP Lens: Hong Kong LGBTQ+ groups stage ‘Rainbow Strength’ fitness contest after Pride market venue axed
zh_title: HKFP镜头：骄傲市场场地被毁后，香港LGBTQ+团体举办“彩虹力量”健身比赛
summary: 香港的 LGBTQ+ 团体举办了一场名为“彩虹力量”的包容性健身活动，此前他们的年度骄傲市场连续第二年面临场地取消的问题，这再次引发了人们对香港城市空间日益缩小的担忧。在彩虹街市突然撤出场地后，香港骄傲委员会于 2026 年 11 月 7 日举办了一场名为“彩虹力量”的健身比赛。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。香港骄傲委员会周六宣布，由 16 名不同性别认同和性取向的参与者参加的健身比赛如期举行。
content:
香港的 LGBTQ+ 团体举办了一场名为“彩虹力量”的包容性健身活动，此前他们的年度骄傲市场连续第二年面临场地取消的问题，这再次引发了人们对香港城市空间日益缩小的担忧。在彩虹街市突然撤出场地后，香港骄傲委员会于 2026 年 11 月 7 日举办了一场名为“彩虹力量”的健身比赛。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。香港同志骄傲委员会周六宣布，由 16 名不同性别认同和性取向的参与者参加的健身比赛按计划进行，标志着今年同志骄傲活动的正式启动。在彩虹街市突然撤出场地后，香港骄傲委员会于 2026 年 11 月 7 日举办了一场名为“彩虹力量”的健身比赛。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。 “彩虹力量”是在原定于本月举行的“彩虹市场”因中央市场突然取消场地预订而取消后举行的。场馆经理华懋集团将此举归因于“预订重叠”，并为这一错误道歉，并承诺全额退款。在彩虹街市突然撤出场地后，香港骄傲委员会于 2026 年 11 月 7 日举办了一场名为“彩虹力量”的健身比赛。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。
骄傲委员会在一份声明中表示，对健身比赛的成功举办深表感谢，并指出近年来大型 LGBTQ+ 权益活动“遭遇挫折”。 在彩虹街市突然撤出场地后，香港骄傲委员会于 2026 年 11 月 7 日举办了一场名为“彩虹力量”的健身比赛。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。委员会表示：“我们相信，大型LGBTQ+维权活动的成功举办，让香港展现出多元化、包容性的国际城市形象，是讲述香港故事的重要组成部分。”在彩虹街市突然撤出场地后，香港骄傲委员会于 2026 年 11 月 7 日举办了一场名为“彩虹力量”的健身比赛。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。健美比赛于观塘室内场地举行，分“沙滩短裤”、“运动装”及“比基尼”三个组别。在彩虹街市突然撤出场地后，香港骄傲委员会于 2026 年 11 月 7 日举办了一场名为“彩虹力量”的健身比赛。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。组织者表示，对参赛者的评估标准包括体格和舞台表现，评审的方式促进性别多样性和相互尊重。在彩虹街市突然撤出场地后，香港骄傲委员会于 2026 年 11 月 7 日举办了一场名为“彩虹力量”的健身比赛。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。
该委员会补充说，参赛者来自香港和海外。 在彩虹街市突然撤出场地后，香港骄傲委员会于 2026 年 11 月 7 日举办了一场名为“彩虹力量”的健身比赛。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。代表香港参加亚运会的前香港健美队队员黄安迪率领五人小组担任比赛的裁判。在彩虹街市突然撤出场地后，香港骄傲委员会于 2026 年 11 月 7 日举办了一场名为“彩虹力量”的健身比赛。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。委员会还表示，彩虹市场将于本月晚些时候作为独家活动举行

LGBTQ+ groups in Hong Kong have staged an inclusive fitness event dubbed “Rainbow Strength,” after their annual Pride market faced venue cancellations for a second consecutive year – renewing concerns over dwindling civic space in the city. The Hong Kong Pride Committee holds a fitness contest dubbed “Rainbow Strength” on November 7, 2026, following an abrupt venue pullout for its Rainbow Market. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The Hong Kong Pride Committee announced on Saturday that the fitness contest – featuring 16 participants across various gender identities and sexual orientations – went ahead as planned, marking the launch of this year’s Pride festivities. The Hong Kong Pride Committee holds a fitness contest dubbed “Rainbow Strength” on November 7, 2026, following an abrupt venue pullout for its Rainbow Market. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. “Rainbow Strength” took place after the “Rainbow Market,” originally scheduled for this month, was scrapped following the sudden cancellation of its venue booking at Central Market. Venue manager Chinachem Group attributed the move to a “booking overlap” and apologised for the mistake, pledging a full refund. The Hong Kong Pride Committee holds a fitness contest dubbed “Rainbow Strength” on November 7, 2026, following an abrupt venue pullout for its Rainbow Market. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. In a statement, the Pride Committee said it was deeply grateful that the fitness contest was successfully held, noting major LGBTQ+ rights events “have run into setbacks” in recent years. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. “We believe that the successful staging of large-scale LGBTQ+ rights events allows Hong Kong to present itself as a diverse and inclusive international city, and is an important part of telling Hong Kong’s story,” the committee said. The fitness competition, held at an indoor location in Kwun Tong, consisted of three divisions: “Beach Shorts,” “Sportswear,” and “Bikini.” The Hong Kong Pride Committee holds a fitness contest dubbed “Rainbow Strength” on November 7, 2026, following an abrupt venue pullout for its Rainbow Market. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Organisers said contestants were evaluated on criteria including physique and stage presence, with the judging conducted in a way that promoted gender diversity and mutual respect. The Hong Kong Pride Committee holds a fitness contest dubbed “Rainbow Strength” on November 7, 2026, following an abrupt venue pullout for its Rainbow Market. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Contestants hailed from Hong Kong and overseas, the committee added. The Hong Kong Pride Committee holds a fitness contest dubbed “Rainbow Strength” on November 7, 2026, following an abrupt venue pullout for its Rainbow Market. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Andy Wong, a former member of the Hong Kong bodybuilding team who represented the city at the Asian Games, led a five-member panel to adjudicate the competition. The Hong Kong Pride Committee holds a fitness contest dubbed “Rainbow Strength” on November 7, 2026, following an abrupt venue pullout for its Rainbow Market. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The committee also said that the Rainbow Market would be held later this month as an exclusive event for its members following the venue cancellation, with details to be announced on social media platforms. The Hong Kong Pride Committee holds a fitness contest dubbed “Rainbow Strength” on November 7, 2026, following an abrupt venue pullout for its Rainbow Market. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The committee comprises four local LGBTQ+ groups: Les Corner Empowerment Association, Rainbow of Hong Kong, the Association for Transgender Rights, and Made in Gender. The groups organised the city’s first Pride Parade in 2008, with the last parade held in 2018. See also: Timeline: Hong Kong civil society’s mysteriously axed venue bookings The committee was denied approval for a march in 2019 over safety concerns and held a static rally instead . The Hong Kong Pride Committee holds a fitness contest dubbed “Rainbow Strength” on November 7, 2026, following an abrupt venue pullout for its Rainbow Market. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The following year, the parade went online due to Covid-19 restrictions. The organisers began adapting their annual Pride Parade into an indoor market event in 2021, owing to what they described as “changes in the social environment.” The Hong Kong Pride Committee holds a fitness contest dubbed “Rainbow Strength” on November 7, 2026, following an abrupt venue pullout for its Rainbow Market. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Last year, organisers booked the Kwun Tong Promenade for the Rainbow Market, but the booking was abruptly axed. The event was instead held at another indoor venue . In September last year, Hong Kong’s legislature voted down a bill to establish legal recognition for same-sex partnerships , dealing a major blow to the city’s LGBTQ+ rights movement.

title: AIT and TECRO Strengthen U.S.-Taiwan Partnership Through New Taiwan Fellowship Program
zh_title: AIT 和 TECRO 通过新的台湾奖学金计划加强美台伙伴关系
summary: AIT 与 TECRO 通过新台湾奖学金计划加强美台伙伴关系 PR-2631 2026 年 11 月 11 日 AIT 与 TECRO 通过新台湾奖学金计划加强美台伙伴关系 2026 年 11 月 10 日，美国在台协会 (AIT) 华盛顿常务董事 Ingrid Larson 与台北驻美国经济文化代表处 (TECRO) 代表 Alexander Tah-Ray Yui 签署了一份建立台湾奖学金计划（TFP）的谅解备忘录（MOU）。 《台湾联谊法》获得国会通过并签署成为法律
content:
AIT 和 TECRO 通过新的台湾奖学金计划加强美国与台湾的伙伴关系 PR-2631 2026 年 11 月 11 日 AIT 和 TECRO 通过新的台湾奖学金计划加强美国与台湾的伙伴关系 2026 年 11 月 10 日，美国在台协会 (AIT) 华盛顿董事总经理 Ingrid Larson 和台北驻美国经济文化代表处 (TECRO) 代表 Alexander Tah-Ray Yui 签署了一份建立台湾奖学金计划（TFP）的谅解备忘录（MOU）。 《台湾奖学金法案》在两党广泛支持下获得国会通过并签署成为法律。今天，AIT 和 TECRO 签署了谅解备忘录，并与国务院教育和文化事务局协调，启动了该计划的实施。该计划的主要目标是扩大和加强美台伙伴关系，并加强美国官员在台湾和海峡两岸问题上的专业知识。 TFP 将在台湾各地建立一批具有语言技能、文化知识和持久工作关系的联邦专业人士。根据该奖学金计划，美国联邦雇员将花费长达一年的时间进行强化普通话培训和地区研究。培训完成后，研究员预计将在台湾议会办公室、部委、其他机构或办公室或台湾公共部门以外的组织工作最长一年。
国会议员以及美国国务院、TECRO 和 AIT 的代表出席了在弗吉尼亚州阿灵顿举行的签字仪式，与会者称赞该计划在加强美台伙伴关系和建立美国政府在台湾问题上的专业知识方面所发挥的作用。美国在台协会董事总经理英格丽·拉尔森 (Ingrid Larson) 表示：“TFP 反映了两党对美台关系的大力支持以及对以民间关系为核心的共同承诺。” 《AIT 和 TECRO 通过新台湾奖学金计划加强美台伙伴关系》一文首先发表在美国在台协会上。

【原文 English Original】
AIT and TECRO Strengthen U.S.-Taiwan Partnership Through New Taiwan Fellowship Program PR-2631 November 11, 2026 AIT and TECRO Strengthen U.S.-Taiwan Partnership Through New Taiwan Fellowship Program   On November 10, 2026, American Institute in Taiwan (AIT) Washington Managing Director Ingrid Larson and the Taipei Economic and Cultural Representative Office in the United States (TECRO) Representative Alexander Tah-Ray Yui signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) to establish the Taiwan Fellowship Program (TFP).   The Taiwan Fellowship Act was passed by Congress and signed into law with broad bipartisan support. Today’s signing of the MOU between AIT and TECRO initiates the program’s implementation, in coordination with the Department of State’s Bureau of Educational and Cultural Affairs. The main objectives of the Program are to expand and strengthen the U.S.-Taiwan partnership, as well as strengthen U.S. officials’ expertise regarding Taiwan and cross-Strait issues. TFP will build a group of federal professionals with language skills, cultural knowledge, and lasting working relationships across Taiwan.   Under the fellowship program, U.S. federal employees will spend up to one year in intensive Mandarin language training and area studies. Upon completion of training, the Fellows are expected to work, for up to one year, in Taiwan parliamentary offices, ministries, other agencies or offices, or organizations outside the public sector in Taiwan.   Members of Congress and representatives from the U.S. Department of State, TECRO, and AIT attended the signing ceremony in Arlington, Virginia, where attendees praised the program’s role in strengthening the U.S.-Taiwan partnership and building U.S. government expertise on Taiwan.   “TFP reflects strong bipartisan support for the U.S.-Taiwan relationship and a shared commitment to the people-to-people ties at its core,” said AIT Managing Director Ingrid Larson. title: Presidential Message on the Birthday of the United States Marine Corps
zh_title: 美国海军陆战队生日总统致辞
summary: 总统关于美国海军陆战队生日的致辞 搜索 选择类别 所有新闻简报和声明 所有总统行动 行政命令 提名和任命 总统备忘录公告情况说明书 发布评论 研究 所有简报和声明 总统行动 所有行政命令 提名和任命 总统备忘录公告情况说明书 发布评论 研究 两个半世纪以来，美国海军陆战队一直是美国精神的生动体现。带着荣誉、勇气和坚定不移
content:
总统关于美国海军陆战队生日的致辞 搜索 选择类别 所有新闻简报和声明 所有总统行动 行政命令 提名和任命 总统备忘录公告情况说明书 发布评论 研究 所有简报和声明 总统行动 所有行政命令 提名和任命 总统备忘录公告情况说明书 发布评论 研究 两个半世纪以来，美国海军陆战队一直是美国精神的生动体现。凭借荣誉、勇气和对维护和推进美国利益的坚定承诺，海军陆战队一再证明，无论困难如何，他们都会响应每一个召唤并完成任何任务。在海军陆战队庆祝保护美国并击败敌人 251 周年之际，我向每一位为我们的国家战斗和牺牲的海军陆战队员致以最深切的谢意，并向他们无与伦比的英勇遗产致敬。从我们共和国诞生之日起，海军陆战队就一直捍卫美国赖以建立的自由和自由的支柱。独立战争期间，海军陆战队出海夺取拿骚港，为大陆军提供大量军需物资增援。在整个第二次世界大战期间，海军陆战队在整个太平洋战区发挥了关键作用，对于美国在关岛、瓜达尔卡纳尔岛、冲绳岛和硫磺岛的胜利至关重要。
这些令人难以置信的“魔鬼犬”在美国历史上无数次冲突的前线服役，从未失败过保护我们国内外的公民，并在我们的对手面前无所畏惧地展示了美国的威力和力量。今天，通过我们勇敢的海军陆战队的英勇无私的服务，美国变得更加安全。美国海军陆战队的爱国男女不断提醒人们美国伟大和荣耀的真正源泉。作为总统，我是我国历史上最强有力的海军陆战队倡导者。通过超级情报的进步以及对导弹防御、下一代能力和造船的投资，我们正在为我们的海军陆战队提供击败美国敌人所需的一切资源，无论他们身在何处。在我的领导下，我们的海军陆战队员也回到家乡，得到他们应得的关怀和支持。我的政府恢复了退伍军人事务部的常识，使退伍军人能够寻求自己选择的医疗保健提供者，降低退伍军人及其家人的费用，并减少有害的积压。作为总司令，我将永远不会停止为我们的海军陆战队挺身而出，维护他们作为世界上最致命的战斗力量的声誉。在座右铭“Semper Fidelis”（意为“永远忠诚”）的指引下，美国海军陆战队在我们国家和全人类的历史上留下了自己的印记。
我们海军陆战队的坚定力量证明了美国精神的力量和美国武装部队的力量。一代又一代，海军陆战队忠实地充当了美国的捍卫者，他们将在未来的几个世纪里继续作为自由的忠实捍卫者。永远Fi！关于美国海军陆战队生日的总统致辞首先出现在白宫。

【原文 English Original】
Presidential Message on the Birthday of the United States Marine Corps Search Select Category All News Briefings & Statements All Presidential Actions Executive Orders Nominations & Appointments Presidential Memoranda Proclamations Fact Sheets Releases Remarks Research All Briefings & Statements Presidential Actions All Executive Orders Nominations & Appointments Presidential Memoranda Proclamations Fact Sheets Releases Remarks Research For over two and a half centuries, the United States Marine Corps has stood as a living embodiment of the American Spirit.  With honor, courage, and unwavering commitment to preserving and advancing the interests of the United States, Marines have proven time and again that they will answer every call and complete any mission no matter the odds.  As the Marine Corps celebrates 251 years of protecting America and defeating her enemies, I extend my deepest gratitude to every Marine who has fought and sacrificed for our Nation and pay tribute to their unmatched legacy of valor. From the dawn of our Republic, Marines have defended the pillars of freedom and liberty that America was founded upon.  During the Revolutionary War, Marines took to the sea to seize the port of Nassau and reinforce the Continental Army with large quantities of military supplies.  Throughout World War II, Marines played a critical role across the Pacific Theater and were essential to American victories at Guam, Guadalcanal, Okinawa, and Iwo Jima.  These incredible Devil Dogs have served on the front lines of countless conflicts throughout American history, never failed to protect our citizens at home and abroad, and fearlessly demonstrated American might and power in the face of our adversaries.  Today, America is made safer through the heroic and selfless service of our brave Marines. The patriotic men and women of the United States Marine Corps are enduring reminders of the true source of American greatness and glory.  As President, I have been the strongest advocate for our Marines in the history of our country.  Through advancements in Super Intelligence and investments in missile defense, next-generation capabilities, and shipbuilding, we are providing our Marines with every resource they need to defeat America’s enemies wherever they may be. Under my leadership, our Marines also return home to the care and support they have so rightly earned.  My Administration has restored common sense at the Department of Veterans Affairs, empowering veterans to seek the healthcare providers of their choice, lowering costs for veterans and their families, and slashing harmful backlogs.  As Commander in Chief, I will never stop standing up for our Marines and upholding their reputation as the most lethal fighting force the world has ever seen. Guided by their motto, Semper Fidelis, meaning “Always Faithful,” the United States Marines have left their mark on the history of our Nation and all of mankind.  The steadfast strength of our Marines is a testament to the power of the American Spirit and the might of the United States Armed Forces.  Generation after generation, Marines have faithfully served as champions of America, and they will carry on as faithful defenders of liberty for centuries to come.  Semper Fi!
